text.en: S. Woodburn Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I: The Loss of Singapore (HMSO, 1957), p. 97 table: the landing in Malaya was planned for 00:45 local time on 8 December (17:15 GMT on the 7th), the attack on Pearl Harbor for 07:55 Hawaii time (18:25 GMT), about 70 minutes later; the Singora landing for 02:30 local time.
text.zh: S. Woodburn Kirby，《对日战争》第一卷《新加坡的失陷》（英国皇家文书局，1957），第 97 页表：马来亚登陆计划在 12 月 8 日当地时间 0 时 45 分（格林尼治 7 日 17 时 15 分），珍珠港攻击在夏威夷时间 7 时 55 分（格林尼治 18 时 25 分），晚约 70 分钟；宋卡登陆在当地时间 2 时 30 分。

note.en: Kirby notes conflicting evidence on the exact time of the first landing at Kota Bharu; it was probably close to the planned time.
note.zh: Kirby 指出哥打巴鲁第一批登陆的确切时间说法不一，大概接近计划时间。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, Appendix 18, p. 527: Japanese first flights landed about 13,500 men at Singora, 7,550 at Patani and 5,590 at Kota Bharu, 26,640 in all (17,230 combat troops).
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷附录 18（第 527 页）：日军第一批在宋卡登陆约 13,500 人，北大年 7,550 人，哥打巴鲁 5,590 人，共 26,640 人（战斗部队 17,230 人）。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 411, 414–415: on the morning of 14 February the water engineer reported that breaks in the mains were losing more than half the supply, which might last 24–48 hours; at 5.15 p.m. on 15 February 1942 Percival met Yamashita at the Ford factory at Bukit Timah; he signed the terms at 6.10 p.m.; fighting ceased at 8.30 p.m., ending a campaign of 70 days.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 411、414–415 页：2 月 14 日早上水务工程师报告水管破裂使一半以上供水流失，最多维持 24–48 小时；1942 年 2 月 15 日下午 5 时 15 分，白思华在武吉知马的福特车厂会见山下奉文，6 时 10 分签字；晚 8 时 30 分停火，战役历时 70 天。

text.en: Kirby, The War Against Japan, vol. I, pp. 183, 323: during the first raid on 8 December 1941 Singapore was fully lit and the street lamps were not put out until the all-clear at 4.40 a.m.; known civilian casualties from air raids during January 1942 were some 600 killed and 1,500 injured.
text.zh: Kirby《对日战争》第一卷第 183、323 页：1941 年 12 月 8 日首次空袭时新加坡灯火通明，路灯到凌晨 4 时 40 分解除警报后才熄灭；1942 年 1 月空袭已知的平民伤亡约为 600 人死亡、1,500 人受伤。

note.en: A Singapore government account gives more than 1,000 killed in January [S37]; both are listed.
note.zh: 新加坡政府的资料写 1 月死亡 1,000 多人 [S37]；两者并列。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'First Japanese air raid in Singapore on 8 Dec 1941': 17 bombers attacked the city and air bases; the raid left 61 dead and 133 injured; by January 1942 there were two to three raids a day, killing more than 1,000 people that month.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《1941 年 12 月 8 日日军首次空袭新加坡》：17 架轰炸机袭击市区和机场，造成 61 人死亡、133 人受伤；到 1942 年 1 月每天有两三次空袭，当月 1,000 多人死亡。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Overcrowding in Alexandra Military Hospital on 14 Feb 1942': Japanese soldiers bayoneted 50 unarmed patients and medical staff in the wards; about 200 patients and staff were marched to another building, held overnight and shot the next day.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《1942 年 2 月 14 日人满为患的亚历山大军医院》：日军士兵在病房里用刺刀杀死 50 名手无寸铁的病人和医护人员；约 200 名病人和医护人员被押到另一栋楼，关押一夜，次日被枪杀。

note.en: Kirby records the Japanese justification that the hospital had been used as an artillery position (Kirby, vol. I, p. 414).
note.zh: Kirby 记录了日方的说法：医院曾被用作炮兵阵地（Kirby 第一卷第 414 页）。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board, Singapore), 'Lieutenant Adnan and the Battle of Bukit Chandu': on 13–14 February 1942 C Company, 1st Battalion, Malay Regiment, held Bukit Chandu; Second Lieutenant Adnan Saidi was captured and killed.

note.zh: 已读：开头几段史实；后文明确是小说式的叙事，不用来重建史实。简短证据引文：“兵变持续将近一周，夺去 44 人的生命”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Triads, Coolies and Pimps: Chinatown in Former Times (NLB Biblio Asia, 2015)
text.zh: 《私会党、苦力与皮条客：旧日的牛车水》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》，2015）

note.en: Read: Opening section on May 1854 violence. Short evidence quotation: “the clashes left some 500 people dead”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：开头关于 1854 年 5 月暴力冲突的一节。简短证据引文：“冲突造成约 500 人死亡”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Vandana Aggarwal, The Extraordinary Life of Kunnuck Mistree (NLB Biblio Asia, 2021)
text.zh: Vandana Aggarwal《Kunnuck Mistree 的非凡人生》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》，2021）

note.en: Read: First three paragraphs and account of named convict. Short evidence quotation: “on 18 April 1825 on the brig Horatio”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：前三段，以及关于这名有名有姓的囚犯的记述。简短证据引文：“1825 年 4 月 18 日搭乘双桅船 Horatio 号”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Sarawak Government, Limbang book, printed p. 17 / HTML page 19
text.zh: 砂拉越政府《林梦》专书，印本第 17 页（HTML 第 19 页）

note.en: Read: Malay text on Limbang incorporation 17 March 1890 and Lawas acquisition 12 January 1905. Short evidence quotation: “Pada 12 Januari tahun 1905 semua kawasan ini telah dibeli oleh Sarawak”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：关于 1890 年 3 月 17 日林梦并入砂拉越和 1905 年 1 月 12 日取得老越的马来文原文。简短证据引文：“1905 年 1 月 12 日，这一带全部已被砂拉越买下”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, Time-honoured Temple Design (2016)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《历久弥新的庙宇设计》（2016）

note.en: Read historical foundation and successive rebuilding paragraphs: land allocated 1823, first wood-and-attap temple 1827, brick replacement 1843, major reconstruction 1862–63. This supports foundation chronology, not precise surveyed coordinates.
note.zh: 已读关于建庙和历次重建的段落：1823 年拨地，1827 年建成第一座木结构、亚答屋顶的庙宇，1843 年改建为砖庙，1862–63 年大规模重建。这支持建庙的年代顺序，不提供经过测量的精确坐标。

text.en: Masjid Jamae (Chulia), official institutional history
text.zh: 詹美回教堂（Chulia）官方机构史

note.en: Read historical narrative and timeline on the mosque’s institutional website, including its 1826 origin and later building history. Location is South Bridge Road; no coordinate is asserted as newly surveyed.
note.zh: 已读回教堂官方网站上的历史叙述和年表，包括 1826 年的起源和后来的建筑历史。位置在桥南路；没有声称重新测量过坐标。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, The Singapore Hokkien Huay Kuan Collection: A Treasure Trove of Information (2024)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《新加坡福建会馆藏品：信息宝库》（2024）

note.en: Read discussion of original land deeds and temple history: prayerhouse 1821, present temple construction  1839–1842, Telok Ayer Street shoreline. The deeds described by the article were not separately inspected.
note.zh: 已读关于原始地契和庙宇历史的讨论：1821 年的祈祷所，1839–1842 年修建现在的庙宇，当时直落亚逸街就在海岸线上。文章描述的地契没有另行查看。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, From Pauper to Philanthropist: The Tan Tock Seng Story (2017)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《从贫民到慈善家：陈笃生的故事》（2017）

note.en: Read hospital financing and first-site paragraphs: Pearl’s Hill; article gives foundation 25 May 1844 and completion 1846/operation 1849. The hospital’s own heritage page and NLBphoto catalog give 25 July 1844. This draft retains 1844 yearonly; precise original-site coordinate remains unverified.
note.zh: 已读关于医院经费和第一处院址的段落：珍珠山；文章写 1844 年 5 月 25 日奠基，1846 年落成，1849 年启用。医院自己的文物网页和 NLBphoto 目录写 1844 年 7 月 25 日。本稿只保留 1844 年这个年份；原址的精确坐标仍未核实。

text.en: Armenian Church Singapore, About the Armenian Church
text.zh: 新加坡亚米尼亚教堂《关于亚米尼亚教堂》

note.en: Read institutional historical account,1835 construction and community links withIndia/Java. Foundation/building chronology is distinct from 1836 consecration; no new coordinate verification.
note.zh: 已读教堂的机构历史记述：1835 年建造，以及社群与印度、爪哇的联系。奠基和建造的年代与 1836 年的祝圣是两回事；没有重新核实坐标。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, From Sea to Road: Building the Causeway (2020)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《从海路到陆路：修建长堤》（2020）

note.en: Read construction, early rail service and opening sections: officialcompletion 11 June 1924, ceremony 28 June 1924; railtrafficprecedesroadopening. Exact railway path remains forG 11 georeferencedtrace, not derived from prose.
note.zh: 已读关于施工、早期铁路服务和启用的段落：1924 年 6 月 11 日正式完工，1924 年 6 月 28 日举行典礼；铁路通车早于公路开通。铁路的确切走向留给 G11 的地理配准描摹，不从文字推出。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, Land From Sand: Singapore’s Reclamation Story (2017)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《从沙到地：新加坡填海的故事》（2017）

note.en: Read first reclamation, CollyerQuayandTelok Ayerparagraphs. It dates Telok AyerScheme 1879–1897, correcting spec 1887 completionclaim. This prose establishes project chronology, not a shoreline polygon; the historicalmaps must establish each coast-era shape.
note.zh: 已读关于第一次填海、哥烈码头和直落亚逸的段落。文章把直落亚逸填海计划定在 1879–1897 年，纠正了内容规格里 1887 年完成的说法。这段文字确立的是工程年代，不是海岸线多边形；每个时期的海岸形状必须由历史地图确定。

text.en: Royal Malaysia Police, Pasukan Polis Negeri-Negeri Melayu Bersekutu
text.zh: 马来西亚皇家警察《马来联邦警察部队》

note.en: Read full Malay institutional history; states federation became effective  1 July 1896  and lists four member states. A colonial agreement in 1895 and effective federation  1896 are distinct milestones.
note.zh: 已读马来文机构史全文；文中说联邦于 1896 年 7 月 1 日生效，并列出四个成员州。1895 年的殖民地协议和 1896 年联邦生效是两个不同的节点。

text.en: State of Perak, Dindings Cession (Amendment) Enactment 6 of 1954, Gazette 28 December 1954, p.901
text.zh: 霹雳州《1954 年第 6 号天定割让（修正）法令》，1954 年 12 月 28 日宪报，第 901 页

note.en: Read the complete indexed text of this one-page official enactment. Its preamble describes Dindings as ceded to Perak in 1935 and identifies the principal enactment as No.2/35. Direct scan retrieval timed out, so the precise handover day and principal enactment remain unverified; this source confirms the year only.
note.zh: 已读这份一页官方法令被索引的全文。序言说天定于 1935 年割让给霹雳，并指明主法令为第 2/35 号。直接获取扫描件超时，所以具体移交日期和主法令仍未核实；这份来源只确认年份。

text.en: One Hundred Years of Singapore, volume I (1921), Historical chapter, p.31
text.zh: 《新加坡百年》第一卷（1921），历史章，第 31 页

note.en: Read the public-domain OCR of printed p.31: Letters Patent dated 30 October 1906; incorporation in the Straits Settlements effective 1 January 1907; separate settlement from 1 December 1912. The original Letters Patent and proclamation were not independently retrieved. This contemporary colonial history is used for administrative chronology, not as a neutral account of colonial rule.
note.zh: 已读印本第 31 页的公有领域 OCR 文本：特许状日期为 1906 年 10 月 30 日；1907 年 1 月 1 日起并入海峡殖民地；1912 年 12 月 1 日起成为单独的一块属地。特许状和公告的原件没有另行取得。这部同时代的殖民地历史只用来确定行政年代，不当作对殖民统治的中立叙述。

text.en: Pangkor Engagement, 20 January 1874, reproduced by NUS Empire in Asia Documents Archive
text.zh: 《邦咯条约》（1874 年 1 月 20 日），新加坡国立大学 Empire in Asia 文献档案库转载

note.en: Read the full reproduced primary text, articles I–XIV and execution clause; the page identifies Allen, Stockwell and Wright, Collection of Treaties, volume I (1981), pp.390–392. Article VI requires Resident advice except Malay religion and custom; articles I–II concern the disputed succession. The prefatory colonial allegations are attributed rather than adopted as the topic’s narrative.
note.zh: 已读转载的原始文本全文，包括第一至第十四条和签署条款；页面注明出处为 Allen、Stockwell 和 Wright 编《条约集》第一卷（1981）第 390–392 页。第六条规定须听从驻扎官的意见，马来宗教和习俗除外；第一、二条涉及有争议的王位继承。前言中殖民方面的指控标明出处，不当作本主题的叙述。

text.en: Jumaah Majlis DiRaja Johor, Kedaulatan dan Ketuanan Negeri Johor, section on the 11 December 1885 agreement
text.zh: 柔佛皇家议会《柔佛州的主权与统治权》，关于 1885 年 12 月 11 日协定的一节

note.en: Read the full Malay institutional account of the 1885 agreement and its seven clauses. It gives London, 11 December 1885, identifies the signatories and describes the consular agent and foreign-relations restrictions. Original treaty copies are pictured on the page but were not independently transcribed here. This is the Johor royal institution’s account; its evaluative claims are not reproduced.
note.zh: 已读这份马来文机构记述中关于 1885 年协定及其七项条款的全文。它写明协定于 1885 年 12 月 11 日在伦敦签订，列出签署人，并描述领事代理和对外关系方面的限制。页面上有条约原件的图片，但本处没有另行转录。这是柔佛王室机构的记述；其中的评价性说法没有照搬。

text.en: National Army Museum, Perak campaign medal, accession 2020-07-20-1-1
text.zh: 英国国家陆军博物馆，霹雳战役勋章，藏品编号 2020-07-20-1-1

note.en: Read the entire collection description. It dates the campaign 1875–1876, identifies British and imperial forces and Malay resistance, and links Birch’s killing to reinforcements and assaults on strongholds. It is a British military museum account, not a casualty register. No military or civilian total is inferred.
note.zh: 已读藏品说明全文。说明把战役定在 1875–1876 年，指出交战双方是英国和帝国军队与马来人的抵抗力量，并把毕治（Birch）被杀与英方增兵、进攻据点联系起来。这是英国军事博物馆的记述，不是伤亡名册。没有据此推算任何军人或平民伤亡总数。

text.en: C.B. Buckley, An Anecdotal History of Old Times in Singapore, volume I (1902), pp.180 and217–219
text.zh: C. B. Buckley《新加坡旧日轶事史》第一卷（1902），第 180 页和第 217–219 页

note.en: Read public-domain OCR of printed p.180 on the March–April1825 British reoccupation of Malacca and pp.217–219 on the1831 first Naning expedition and1832 reinforcements. The account represents a colonial author and reproduces colonial assumptions; these are not adopted as narrative judgements. No casualty estimate is inferred.
note.zh: 已读印本第 180 页的公有领域 OCR 文本，内容是 1825 年 3–4 月英国重新占领马六甲；第 217–219 页是 1831 年第一次南宁远征和 1832 年的增援。这是殖民时代作者的记述，带有殖民者的假设，本主题不采用其中的叙述判断。没有据此推算伤亡数字。

text.en: Hong Kong Government, Hong Kong2006 yearbook, History
text.zh: 香港政府《香港年报 2006》，历史章

note.en: Read the indexed official yearbook paragraph on the Chuenpi convention and occupation ceremony: flag hoisted at Possession Point26January1841. Direct open failed; this is an indexed institutional chronology, not inspection of an1841original instrument.
note.zh: 已读官方年报中被索引的一段，内容是《穿鼻草约》和占领仪式：1841 年 1 月 26 日在水坑口（Possession Point）升旗。直接打开失败；这是被索引的机构年表，不是查看过 1841 年的原始文件。

text.en: Suez Canal Authority, Canal History, inauguration section
text.zh: 苏伊士运河管理局《运河历史》，通航典礼一节

note.en: Read the institutional account of concession, excavation, inauguration and later development, relying only on the opening date17November1869 here. The page’s celebratory language and political characterisations are not reproduced. No claim about months saved on a particular voyage is inferred.
note.zh: 已读机构关于特许权、开凿、通航和后来发展的记述，这里只采用通航日期 1869 年 11 月 17 日。页面上的颂扬语言和政治评价没有照搬。没有据此推断某次航行节省了几个月。

text.en: NLB BiblioAsia, The Story of Two Shipyards: Keppel & Sembawang (2019)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》《两座船坞的故事：吉宝与三巴旺》（2019）

note.en: Read the article’s Competition, Monopoly and Government Takeover section: the Tanjong Pagar Dock Company was organised in1864 to finance a drydock; this is distinct from first drydock1859 and the opening of later facilities. Bogaars1956 is cited by the article but was not separately read.
note.zh: 已读文章“竞争、垄断与政府接管”一节：丹戎巴葛船坞公司于 1864 年成立，为修建干船坞筹资；这与 1859 年的第一座干船坞以及后来设施的启用是不同的事。文章引用的 Bogaars（1956）没有另行阅读。

text.en: Lim Tin Seng, 'From Exclusive to Inclusive Remembrance: The Civilian War Memorial', BiblioAsia 7(2), Jul 2011 (National Library Board): 'The Japanese put the figure at about 5,000, while the Chinese estimated it to be around 100,000. But it has been widely assumed that the number of victims was between 25,000 and 50,000.' After the operation the Chinese community had to raise $50 million as 'tribute money'. In February 1962 a mass grave was unearthed at Siglap; the Singapore Chinese Chamber of Commerce searched for others and demanded a 'blood debt' from Japan. The Civilian War Memorial was unveiled on 15 February 1967, and a commemorative service is held there every 15 February.
text.zh: 林振胜《从排他到包容的纪念：日据时期死难人民纪念碑》，《BiblioAsia》第 7 卷第 2 期（2011 年 7 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：“日方估计约 5,000 人，华人估计约 10 万人。但一般认为遇难者在 25,000 至 50,000 人之间。”行动之后，华人社会被迫筹集 5,000 万元“奉纳金”。1962 年 2 月实里达（Siglap）发现集体坟场；中华总商会寻找其他坟场，并向日本要求偿还“血债”。纪念碑于 1967 年 2 月 15 日揭幕，此后每年 2 月 15 日在碑前举行纪念仪式。

text.en: Wai Keng Kwok, Justice Done? Criminal and Moral Responsibility Issues in the Chinese Massacres Trial, Singapore, 1947 (Yale University Genocide Studies Program, Working Paper 18, 2001): Chinese 'males aged eighteen to fifty should present themselves for inspection'; 'officially, the "Chinese Massacres" Trial of March 1947 puts the number at around five thousand but unofficially … as high as fifty thousand'.
text.zh: Wai Keng Kwok《正义得到伸张了吗？1947 年新加坡“华侨大屠杀”审判中的刑事与道德责任问题》（耶鲁大学种族灭绝研究项目工作论文第 18 号，2001）：“18 岁至 50 岁的华人男子须前往接受检查”；“1947 年 3 月的‘华侨大屠杀’审判官方认定的人数约为 5,000，但非官方的估计……高达 5 万”。

text.en: Hayashi Hirofumi (Kanto Gakuin University), 'Massacre of Chinese in Singapore and its Coverage in Postwar Japan': mass screening was carried out mainly by Kempeitai personnel between 21 and 23 February 1942 in the urban areas and by the Imperial Guard Division at the end of February in the suburbs; those picked out were taken to the coast and machine-gunned. The diary of the Kempeitai commander Kawamura Saburō gives 5,000 killed; a 25th Army intelligence record of 28 May 1942 gives 11,110 'missing as a result of bombing and the purge'.
text.zh: 林博史（关东学院大学）《新加坡华侨大屠杀及其在战后日本的报道》：大检证在市区主要由宪兵队于 1942 年 2 月 21 日至 23 日进行，郊区由近卫师团在 2 月底进行；被挑出的人被押到海边用机枪扫射。宪兵队指挥官河村参郎的日记记为 5,000 人；第 25 军 1942 年 5 月 28 日的情报记录记为“因轰炸和肃清而失踪”11,110 人。

note.en: Hayashi notes that the credibility of the 11,110 figure is open to question; he regards the real number as considerably higher than the Japanese records.
note.zh: 林博史指出 11,110 这个数字的可信度存疑；日方记录普遍低于实际人数。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site marker 'Changi Beach Massacre': 66 Chinese male civilians were killed by Japanese hojo kempei (auxiliary military police) firing squads at the water's edge on Changi Beach on 20 February 1942, during the Sook Ching operation (18 February – 4 March 1942).
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹标志“樟宜海滩屠杀”：1942 年 2 月 20 日，66 名华人男性平民在樟宜海滩水边被日本辅助宪兵行刑队枪杀；这是肃清行动（1942 年 2 月 18 日至 3 月 4 日）的一部分。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site marker 'Punggol Beach Massacre': on 28 February 1942 some 400 Chinese civilians, victims of the Sook Ching purge, were killed by the Japanese on this north-eastern shore.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹标志“榜鹅海滩屠杀”：1942 年 2 月 28 日，约 400 名华人平民在这片东北海岸被日军杀害，他们是肃清行动的受害者。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Punggol Beach: an Operation Sook Ching site': from 21 February to 4 March 1942 Chinese males between the ages of 18 and 50 were summoned to mass screening centres; those identified as anti-Japanese were taken away and killed.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《榜鹅海滩：肃清行动地点》：1942 年 2 月 21 日至 3 月 4 日，18 至 50 岁的华人男子被召集到各大检证中心；被认定为“抗日分子”的人被带走杀害。

text.en: Lee Geok Boi, 'Wartime Victuals: Surviving the Japanese Occupation', BiblioAsia 15(1), Apr–Jun 2019 (National Library Board): the population of Syonan was around 900,000 in 1943; the rice ration started at 20 katis (about 12 kg) a month per person, dropping to 8 katis for men, 6 for women and 4 per child; people switched to tapioca and sweet potatoes; 'banana money' became worthless through runaway inflation — an egg cost 3 cents before the war and $100 at the end of the occupation, a kati of pork 30 cents and then $1,500; between 1942 and 1945 recorded deaths more than doubled, from 29,831 to 65,158.
text.zh: 李玉美《战时饮食：在日据时期活下来》，《BiblioAsia》第 15 卷第 1 期（2019 年 4–6 月，新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：1943 年昭南人口约 90 万；大米配给起初每人每月 20 斤（约 12 公斤），后来降到男子 8 斤、女子 6 斤、儿童 4 斤；人们改吃木薯和番薯；“香蕉钱”因通货膨胀失去价值——战前一个鸡蛋 3 分钱，占领末期 100 元，一斤猪肉从 3 角涨到 1,500 元；1942 至 1945 年间登记死亡人数增加一倍多，从 29,831 人增至 65,158 人。

note.en: The prices come from the oral history of the businessman Chua Eng Cheow (National Archives of Singapore). A kati is about 600 g.
note.zh: 物价出自商人蔡荣祥的口述历史（新加坡国家档案馆）。1 斤约 600 克。

text.en: Australian War Memorial, 'F Force on the Burma–Thailand Railway': working parties of prisoners had begun work on the railway by June 1942; the 415 km of rail between Thanbyuzayat and Nong Pladuk were joined on 17 October 1943 at Konkoita; F Force's trains travelled north from Singapore for five days to Ban Pong; 'of the 62,000 Allied prisoners of war used on the Burma–Thailand Railway, 11,979 died'; 87,000 prisoners rotated through Changi during the war.
text.zh: 澳大利亚战争纪念馆《泰缅铁路上的 F 部队》：到 1942 年 6 月已有战俘工作队开始修路；泰国丹彪扎亚至农布拉杜克之间 415 公里的铁路于 1943 年 10 月 17 日在 Konkoita 接通；F 部队的列车从新加坡北上五天到达班蓬；“修建泰缅铁路的 62,000 名盟军战俘中，11,979 人死亡”；战争期间先后有 87,000 名战俘经过樟宜。

text.en: Australian War Memorial, 'Stolen Years: Australian prisoners of war — The Burma–Thailand Railway': the railway was built by about 60,000 Allied prisoners of war and 200,000 romusha (Asian labourers); by its completion in October 1943 at least 2,815 Australians, over 11,000 other Allied prisoners and perhaps 75,000 romusha were dead.
text.zh: 澳大利亚战争纪念馆《被偷走的岁月：澳大利亚战俘——泰缅铁路》：铁路由约 6 万名盟军战俘和 20 万名亚洲劳工（romusha）修建；到 1943 年 10 月完工时，至少 2,815 名澳大利亚人、11,000 多名其他盟军战俘和大约 75,000 名亚洲劳工已经死亡。

text.zh: 澳大利亚政府退伍军人事务部 Anzac Portal《铁路上的劳务者》：泰缅铁路上死亡的亚洲劳工多达 9 万人；他们大多没有标明的坟墓，一座纪念碑纪念约 9 万名亚洲劳工。

note.en: The portal did not respond to automated access; the figure was checked through search-engine extracts of its pages. No count was kept of the labourers, so all figures are estimates; the Australian War Memorial gives 'perhaps 75,000' [S103]. Both are listed.

text.en: Australian High Commission, Singapore, 'Operation Jaywick' (2013): on 26 September 1943 fourteen Australian and British commandos in canoes sank or damaged about 37,000 tonnes of shipping in Singapore harbour; on 10 October 1943 (the 'Double Tenth') the Kempeitai took away 57 civilian internees from Changi Gaol for interrogation, and fifteen of them died during interrogation; the later round-up included Choy Khun Heng and Elizabeth Choy.
text.zh: 澳大利亚驻新加坡高级专员公署《杰威克行动》（2013）：1943 年 9 月 26 日，14 名澳大利亚和英国突击队员乘独木舟潜入新加坡港，击沉或炸伤约 37,000 吨船只；1943 年 10 月 10 日（“双十”）宪兵队从樟宜监狱带走 57 名被拘留的平民审讯，其中 15 人在审讯中死亡；随后的大搜捕中还有蔡坤兴和伊丽莎白·蔡（蔡秀美）。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Changi Prison Gate Wall and Turrets' (National Monument): on 17 February 1942 European civilians were marched to Changi, and more than 2,500 civilians and POWs, including the entire British civil service, were packed into the prison; ill-treatment of internees worsened after the 'Double Tenth Incident' of 10 October 1943, when the Kempeitai raided the cells after Operation Jaywick.

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), story 'Lim Bo Seng' and the Force 136 historic marker: Lim Bo Seng (27 April 1909 – 29 June 1944) escaped to India and joined Force 136, recruiting Chinese agents to gather intelligence in Malaya; after the network was betrayed he was arrested, starved and tortured by the Japanese military police at Batu Gajah Gaol (Perak), where he died aged 35; after the war he was buried with military honours at MacRitchie Reservoir. Force 136 was part of Britain's Special Operations Executive (SOE), headquartered in Kandy, Ceylon; it recruited local Chinese and Malays and landed agents in Malaya by submarine.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）故事“林谋盛”与“136 部队”史迹标志：林谋盛（1909 年 4 月 27 日—1944 年 6 月 29 日）逃到印度，加入 136 部队，招募华人特工到马来亚搜集情报；情报网遭出卖后他被捕，在霹雳州华都牙也（Batu Gajah）监狱被日本宪兵饿饭、拷打，死时 35 岁；战后以军礼葬于麦里芝蓄水池。136 部队属于英国特别行动处（SOE），总部设在锡兰康提，招募本地华人和马来人，用潜艇把特工送进马来亚。

text.en: Singapore Council of Women's Organisations, Singapore Women's Hall of Fame, 'Elizabeth Choy': she and her husband ran a canteen at what is now Woodbridge Hospital and secretly carried food, medicine, money, letters and radios to British prisoners of war; arrested in 1943, she was held for 193 days and repeatedly tortured, including with electric shocks; after returning to Singapore in 1949 she became the first and only woman member of the Legislative Council, and left politics in 1955 to teach.
text.zh: 新加坡妇女组织理事会“新加坡女性名人堂”《伊丽莎白·蔡》：她和丈夫在今天的板桥医院经营食堂，暗中给英国战俘送食物、药品、钱、信件和收音机；1943 年被捕，被关押 193 天，多次受酷刑，包括电击；1949 年回到新加坡后，成为立法议会第一位、也是唯一一位女议员，1955 年离开政坛去教书。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), historic site 'Kempeitai East District Branch': the former YMCA building on Stamford Road was the headquarters of the Kempeitai's East District Branch under Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, with about 200 regular Kempeitai and 1,000 auxiliaries; suspects were held and tortured there, among them Elizabeth Choy and her husband, arrested in October 1943; the building was pulled down in 1981.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）史迹“宪兵队东区分队”：史丹福路的旧基督教青年会（YMCA）大楼是大石正幸中佐指挥的宪兵队东区分队总部，有正规宪兵约 200 人、辅助宪兵 1,000 人；嫌疑人被关押在这里并遭拷打，其中有 1943 年 10 月被捕的伊丽莎白·蔡和她的丈夫；大楼于 1981 年拆除。

text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“旧福特车厂”（国家古迹）：1942 年 2 月 15 日白思华在车厂与山下奉文会面，当晚在会议室签署无条件投降书；日据时期日产公司用这座工厂组装军用车辆。

text.en: Roots.sg (National Heritage Board), 'Former City Hall' (National Monument): in the Municipal Building, Admiral Lord Louis Mountbatten, Supreme Allied Commander South East Asia, accepted the surrender from General Itagaki Seishirō on 12 September 1945, followed by a victory parade on the Padang; in 1959 Lee Kuan Yew and his ministers were sworn in there, and on 16 September 1963 he read the Proclamation of Malaysia from its steps.
text.zh: Roots.sg（新加坡国家文物局）“旧市政厅”（国家古迹）：1945 年 9 月 12 日，东南亚盟军最高统帅蒙巴顿海军上将在市政大厦接受板垣征四郎大将投降，随后在大草场举行胜利游行；1959 年李光耀和他的部长们在这里宣誓就职，1963 年 9 月 16 日他在大厦台阶上宣读马来西亚成立宣言。

text.en: Timothy Pwee, 'A War Crimes Trial Snapshot', BiblioAsia, 1 January 2016 (National Library Board): 131 war-crimes trials were held in Singapore between 21 January 1946 and 12 March 1948; the 'Double Tenth' trial (18 March – 15 April 1946) involved 21 Japanese soldiers and interpreters accused of torturing and killing internees of Changi Prison, where the Kempeitai had raided on 10 October 1943 and found a wireless set, after which 57 internees were tortured and interrogated over several months and 15 died; the main Sook Ching trial, at the Victoria Memorial Hall from 10 March to 2 April 1947, found all seven accused officers guilty — Lieutenant-General Kawamura Saburō and Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki were sentenced to death and the other five to life imprisonment; the figure most often quoted for the Sook Ching comes from an affidavit by Lieutenant-Colonel Hishakari Takafumi, then a newspaper correspondent, that the plan was to kill 50,000 Chinese and half that number had been reached when the order came to stop.
text.zh: Timothy Pwee《战犯审判掠影》，《BiblioAsia》2016 年 1 月 1 日（新加坡国家图书馆管理局）：1946 年 1 月 21 日至 1948 年 3 月 12 日，新加坡共举行 131 场战犯审判；“双十”审判（1946 年 3 月 18 日至 4 月 15 日）的被告是 21 名日本军人和翻译，罪名是拷打和杀害樟宜监狱的被拘留者——1943 年 10 月 10 日宪兵队搜查监狱、搜出一台无线电，此后 57 名被拘留者在几个月里受到拷打审讯，15 人死亡；肃清案的主审判 1947 年 3 月 10 日至 4 月 2 日在维多利亚纪念堂举行，七名被告军官全部有罪，河村参郎中将和大石正幸中佐被判死刑，其余五人终身监禁；关于肃清人数，最常被引用的是当时任报社记者的Hishakari Takafumi 中佐的宣誓书：计划杀 5 万名华人，杀到一半时接到停止的命令。

note.en: Read: Full institutional article, E W Barker oral-history quotation and comparison of proclamations. Short evidence quotation: “read over Radio Singapura on 9 August 1965 at 10 a.m.”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：机构文章全文，包括巴克（E. W. Barker）的口述历史引文和几份宣言的比较。简短证据引文：“1965 年 8 月 9 日上午 10 时在新加坡电台宣读”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: S. Woodburn Kirby and others, The War Against Japan, vol. V: The Surrender of Japan (HMSO, 1969), pp. 249, 265–273: Rear-Admiral Holland in the cruiser Sussex arrived off Singapore on 4 September 1945 escorting the convoys carrying 5th Indian Division and XV Corps headquarters from Rangoon; that evening General Itagaki and Vice-Admiral Fukudome signed aboard Sussex the surrender of Singapore and Johore, where Japanese strength was 50,118 army and air force and 26,872 naval personnel; the occupation began at 11 a.m. on 5 September; on 12 September, in the Municipal Buildings, Mountbatten accepted the surrender of all Japanese forces in South-East Asia and Itagaki signed eleven copies of the Instrument of Surrender; by the end of September some 53,700 prisoners and internees had been evacuated from South-East Asia, mostly by sea from Singapore, and by May 1946 South-East Asia Command had recovered 80,419 prisoners of war and 16,156 internees.
text.zh: S. Woodburn Kirby 等，《对日战争》第五卷《日本投降》（英国皇家文书局，1969）第 249、265–273 页：1945 年 9 月 4 日，霍兰少将乘萨塞克斯号巡洋舰护送从仰光运载印度第 5 师和第 15 军军部的船队抵达新加坡外海；当晚板垣征四郎大将和福留繁海军中将在萨塞克斯号上签署新加坡和柔佛的投降书，当地日军有陆军和航空兵 50,118 人、海军 26,872 人；9 月 5 日上午 11 时开始占领；9 月 12 日，蒙巴顿在市政大厦接受东南亚全部日军投降，板垣签署了十一份投降书；到 9 月底已有约 53,700 名战俘和被拘留者撤离东南亚，大多经海路从新加坡出发；到 1946 年 5 月，东南亚司令部共接回战俘 80,419 人、被拘留平民 16,156 人。

text.en: SG101 (Government of Singapore), 'Singapore in State of Emergency': after three European planters were killed by communist guerrillas in Perak on 16 June 1948, Britain declared a state of Emergency in Malaya two days later and Singapore followed on 24 June 1948; the Emergency lasted twelve years, until 1960.
text.zh: SG101（新加坡政府）《新加坡进入紧急状态》：1948 年 6 月 16 日三名欧洲种植园主在霹雳州被共产党游击队杀害，两天后英国宣布马来亚进入紧急状态，新加坡 1948 年 6 月 24 日跟进；紧急状态持续 12 年，到 1960 年结束。

text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局，阿裕尼路，1995 年照片目录

note.zh: 已读：目录被索引的说明，路名取自 Syed Omar Ali Aljunied。目录关于学校的说法与传记不符，不予沿用。简短证据引文：“以 Syed Omar Ali Aljunied 命名”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

note.en: Read: Full article read; first settlers in late  December 1943; about 3000 residents/about 500 died 1944–45; camp five miles from town. Endau date variants not reconciled. Short evidence quotation: “about 500 died during the 18 months”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文；第一批移民 1943 年 12 月底到达；约 3,000 名居民，1944–45 年间约 500 人死亡；营地离镇上 5 英里。兴楼的日期说法不一，没有统一。简短证据引文：“18 个月里约 500 人死亡”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

note.en: Read: Full transcript read; directly names Rajaratnam Foreign Minister, Lim Kim San Finance, and Goh Defence and Security. Not an appointment instrument for 9 August. Short evidence quotation: “Rajaratnam, the Foreign Minister, and Mr. Lim Kim San, the Finance Minister”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：记录全文；文中直接称拉惹勒南为外交部长、林金山为财政部长、吴庆瑞为国防与安全部长。这不是 8 月 9 日的任命文件。简短证据引文：“外交部长拉惹勒南和财政部长林金山先生”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: NAS, Lee Kuan Yew press conference, 9 August 1965, noon, pp.8,13 and19–22
text.zh: 新加坡国家档案馆，李光耀记者会，1965 年 8 月 9 日中午，第 8、13、19–22 页

note.en: Read: Read primary transcript sections naming Goh’s Defence and Security portfolio and former Finance role, plus Lee’s account of negotiations and anguish. The later 26 August transcript is a separate source. Short evidence quotation: “Dr. Goh is the Minister for Defence and Security”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：原始记录中提到吴庆瑞任国防与安全部长、曾任财政部长的部分，以及李光耀对谈判和内心痛苦的叙述。后来 8 月 26 日的记录是另一份来源。简短证据引文：“吴博士是国防与安全部长”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: The Straits Times, 10 August 1965, p.1, Raja is named Foreign Minister (2015 facsimile reprint)
text.zh: 《海峡时报》1965 年 8 月 10 日第 1 版《拉惹出任外交部长》（2015 年影印重印本）

note.en: Read: Downloaded publisher’s facsimile and visually read lower-right contemporary article. Reports Monday 9 August reshuffle, lists all ten ministers and portfolios. Confirms Defence and Security, and Foreign Affairs and Culture. Later Culture transfer is outside this article. Short evidence quotation: “Mr. Lee Kuan Yew today reshuffled his 10-man Cabinet”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：下载出版社的影印本，目视阅读右下方的当时报道。报道 8 月 9 日星期一的内阁改组，列出全部十名部长及其职务，确认了“国防与安全”和“外交与文化”两项职务。后来文化职务的转移不在这篇报道里。简短证据引文：“李光耀先生今天改组了他的十人内阁”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.zh: Goh Lee Kim《长堤的建造》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局，2024）

note.en: Read: Read full article, an edited extract of the jointly published Malaysian/Singapore National Archives book. Goods trains 17 September 1923, passenger trains 1 October 1923, official completion 11 June 1924, ceremony 28 June 1924. Short evidence quotation: “The official opening of the Causeway on 28 June 1924”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，这是马来西亚和新加坡国家档案馆合作出版一书经过编辑的节选。货运列车 1923 年 9 月 17 日、客运列车 1923 年 10 月 1 日开始通行，1924 年 6 月 11 日正式完工，1924 年 6 月 28 日举行典礼。简短证据引文：“1924 年 6 月 28 日长堤正式开通”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.zh: 《世界学校图书馆》第 14 卷第 1 期（2008 年 1 月），表 1，第 72 页（被索引的摘录）

note.en: Read: Only indexed table text read. Its1931Others value appears as8,275, unlike8,295 in the original UN government return. This may be an OCR or printed error; original journal scan not independently inspected. It is kept as a conflicting lead rather than used to fill the census table. text.zh: 联合国文件 A/2134/Add.8，新加坡政府报告，1952 年 9 月 15 日，印本第 2 页

note.en: Read: Downloaded the complete original government-return scan through the public ODS API. Visually read printed/PDF p.2; all six 1931 community groups and total confirmed. Others is 8,295, resolving the indexed secondary 8,275 discrepancy. Earlier research’s indexed page 6 label was corrected to printed p.2. Short evidence quotation: “Singapore Island in recent decades has been as follows”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：通过联合国公开的 ODS 接口下载政府报告原件的完整扫描件，目视阅读印本／PDF 第 2 页；1931 年六个族群的数字和总数都已确认。“其他”为 8,295，解决了二手索引资料 8,275 的出入。早先研究标注的索引第 6 页已更正为印本第 2 页。简短证据引文：“近几十年来新加坡岛的情况如下”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: United Nations A/5079, Singapore, printed p.105
text.zh: 联合国文件 A/5079，新加坡，印本第 105 页

note.en: Read: Downloaded the complete 6.5 MB original UN government-return scan through the public ODS API. Visually read printed/PDF p.105; all six community groups and total confirmed. Footnote a/ marks the later estimate columns, not the 1957 census column. It excludes nonlocally domiciled Services personnel/families and transients afloat from those later estimates. The 1957 original census report remains unread. Short evidence quotation: “non-locally domiciled Services personnel”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：通过联合国公开的 ODS 接口下载 6.5 MB 的政府报告原件完整扫描件，目视阅读印本／PDF 第 105 页；六个族群的数字和总数都已确认。脚注 a/ 标的是后面几栏估计数，不是 1957 年人口普查那一栏。这些后来的估计不包括非本地户籍的军人及其家属，也不包括船上的流动人口。1957 年人口普查报告原件仍未阅读。简短证据引文：“非本地户籍的军人”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: UK House of Commons, Detained Persons, 12 February 1963, vol.671, cols 171–172 W
text.zh: 英国议会议事录（下议院），《被拘留者》，1963 年 2 月 12 日，第 671 卷第 171–172 栏（书面答复）

note.en: Read: Complete primary parliamentary answer including names. Brockway 107 on 2 February; Sandys 110 on and since 2 February, about 100 that morning. Allegation of subversion remains government assertion. Short evidence quotation: “110 persons have been so detained on and since the 2nd February.”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：议会答复原文全文，包括名单。Brockway 说 2 月 2 日拘留 107 人；Sandys 说 2 月 2 日当天及以后共拘留 110 人，当天早上约 100 人。所谓颠覆活动仍只是政府的说法。简短证据引文：“2 月 2 日当天及以后共有 110 人被这样拘留。”适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Teo Chee Hean, Launch of The Battle for Merger reprint, 9 October 2014 (NAS transcript)
text.zh: 张志贤在《合并的斗争》重印本推介礼上的讲话，2014 年 10 月 9 日（新加坡国家档案馆记录）

note.en: Read: Full 8 page primary government speech read, especially paragraphs 3–14, 19 and notes 4–6: official security interpretation and response to Thum. Short evidence quotation: “there was a communist conspiracy to take power being played out over the merger issue”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：这篇 8 页的政府讲话原文全文，尤其是第 3–14、19 段和注 4–6：官方的安全解读以及对覃炳鑫的回应。简短证据引文：“当时围绕合并问题，正在上演一场共产党夺权的阴谋”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Thum Ping Tjin, ARI Working Paper 211 (2013)
text.zh: 覃炳鑫，新加坡国立大学亚洲研究所工作论文第 211 号（2013）

note.en: Read: Read pp.3–4, 16–21 and references there. Attributes political/anti-colonial interpretation; original British files not separately read. Paper mistakenly dates operation 3 February: primary Hansard supports 2 February. Short evidence quotation: “their chief objections to merger were over the transfer of control of internal security laws”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：第 3–4、16–21 页及其中的参考文献。论文的政治／反殖民解读标明出处；英国原始档案没有另行阅读。论文误把行动日期写成 2 月 3 日，议会议事录原文支持 2 月 2 日。简短证据引文：“他们反对合并的主要理由在于内部安全法律控制权的移交”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.zh: 新加坡选举局《里程碑》，1946–1963 年各节

note.en: Read: Read sections 1–11. Confirms six elected 1948 seats, automatic registration from 1954, electorates 22,395(1948), 300,299(1955), 586,098(1959), referendum 1 September 1962 and election 21 September 1963. Avoid the internally inconsistent 1959 turnoutpercentage. Short evidence quotation: “from 1954, voters were automatically registered”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：第 1–11 节。确认 1948 年有六个民选议席，1954 年起选民自动登记，选民人数为 22,395（1948）、300,299（1955）、586,098（1959），1962 年 9 月 1 日举行全民投票，1963 年 9 月 21 日举行大选。不采用其中自相矛盾的 1959 年投票率百分比。简短证据引文：“1954 年起，选民自动登记”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Elections Department Singapore, 1959 Legislative Assembly General Election Results
text.zh: 新加坡选举局《1959 年立法议院大选结果》

note.en: Read all constituency tables. Recounted the highest Total Votes candidate in each table: 51 tables and 43 PAP winners. Reproducible tally in content-eld 1959-count.json; no number supplied from memory.
note.zh: 已读全部选区表格。逐表重新核对总票数最高的候选人：共 51 个表，人民行动党胜出 43 个。可复核的统计另有记录；没有凭记忆提供任何数字。

text.en: National Library Board, Federation of Malaysia
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《马来西亚联邦》

note.en: Read article sections on the proposal, opposition, referendum, Coldstore, Konfrontasi, election and separation. The article's phrase 71 percent of the population is treated carefully: the topic describes the recorded vote share, not all residents. Its MacDonald House paragraph reports two deaths; the dedicated article records three including a later death. The dedicated casualty source is retained.
note.zh: 已读文章中关于提议、反对、全民投票、冷藏行动、印尼对抗、大选和分家的部分。文章“71% 的人口”的说法要谨慎对待：本主题描述的是记录在案的得票比例，不是全体居民。文章关于麦唐纳大厦的段落说两人死亡；专门的文章记为三人，包括一名后来死亡的人。本主题保留专门的伤亡来源。

text.en: Singapore Legislative Assembly, Order Paper No. 63, 5 September 1962, printed p. 153
text.zh: 新加坡立法议院第 63 号议程表，1962 年 9 月 5 日，印本第 153 页

note.en: Read both pages of the original order paper. The motion identifies 144,077 unmarked ballot papers and 2,370 uncertain ballot papers. It is an order paper proposing treatment of ballots, not evidence that the motion passed.
note.zh: 已读议程表原件两页。动议指出有 144,077 张未作标记的选票和 2,370 张意向不明的选票。这是提议如何处理选票的议程表，不能证明动议获得通过。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Voting card for the National Referendum Paper, accession 1994-05031
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局，全民投票选票卡，藏品编号 1994-05031

note.en: Read indexed collection description returned by search: Option A 70.8 percent, blank votes 25.65 percent, vote date 1 September 1962. Direct page open returned a robot challenge; catalog text requires manual cross-check. These are rounded to about 71 percent and about a quarter in the English draft; differing published denominators must remain visible.
note.zh: 已读搜索返回的被索引藏品说明：选项 A 占 70.8%，空白票占 25.65%，投票日期 1962 年 9 月 1 日。直接打开页面遇到机器人验证；目录文字需要人工复核。英文稿把它们约为“约 71%”和“约四分之一”；各方公布的分母不同，这一点必须保持可见。

text.en: Tan Cheng Bock v Attorney-General [2017] SGHC 160, paragraphs 8–10
text.zh: 陈清木诉总检察长案 [2017] SGHC 160，第 8–10 段

note.en: Read judicial account of the original constitutional instruments, paragraphs 8–10. Parliament passed Act 8 of 1965 on 22 December, retrospectively effective from 9 August. It changed the title and deemed Yusof Ishak President, rather than recording a fresh presidential oath on 22 December. This is a judicial summary; the original 1965 Act was not independently retrieved here.
note.zh: 已读判决书第 8–10 段对原始宪法文件的叙述。国会于 12 月 22 日通过 1965 年第 8 号法令，追溯至 8 月 9 日生效。法令更改了称号，并视尤索夫·伊萨为总统，而不是记录 12 月 22 日另行宣誓就任总统。这是法院的概述；1965 年法令原文没有在本处另行取得。

text.en: Elections Department Singapore, Milestones, sections 1946–1963
text.zh: 新加坡选举局《里程碑》，1946–1963 年各节

note.en: Read sections 1–11 on limited franchise, registration, Rendel reforms, the 1955/1959 elections and 1962 referendum. The displayed 1959 turnout percentage conflicts arithmetically with the article's own raw counts, so no turnout percentage is repeated in this topic.
note.zh: 已读第 1–11 节，内容涉及有限选举权、选民登记、林德改革、1955 年和 1959 年选举以及 1962 年全民投票。页面显示的 1959 年投票率百分比与文章本身的原始数字在算术上矛盾，所以本主题不引用任何投票率百分比。

text.en: URA, Former Kallang Airport conservation portal
text.zh: 市区重建局，旧加冷机场保留网页

note.en: Read: Full conservation page read: reclaimed swamp, opening 12 June 1937. Extent must come from maps, not this prose. Short evidence quotation: “12 June 1937”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：保留网页全文：机场建在填平的沼泽地上，1937 年 6 月 12 日启用。范围必须从地图确定，不能从这段文字推出。简短证据引文：“1937 年 6 月 12 日”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: UK House of Commons, Singapore Disturbances, 9 May 1927
text.zh: 英国议会议事录（下议院），《新加坡骚乱》，1927 年 5 月 9 日

note.en: Read: Read complete primary parliamentary answer quoting the inquest jury. Six men died from police gunshots outside Kreta Ayer Police Station. Exact March day not stated; report attributed through Governor to Colonial Secretary. Short evidence quotation: “these six men met their deaths as the result of gunshot wounds inflicted by the Police”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：议会答复原文全文，其中引述死因研讯陪审团的结论。六名男子在牛车水警察局（Kreta Ayer Police Station）外被警察开枪打死。没有写明是 3 月哪一天；报告由总督转交殖民地大臣。简短证据引文：“这六名男子死于警察开枪造成的枪伤”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Parliament of Singapore, Historical Development, sections1946–1965
text.zh: 新加坡国会《历史沿革》，1946–1965 年各节

note.en: Read institutional constitutional chronology: dissolution of Straits Settlements, separate Singapore colony, Penang/Malacca Malayan Union, limited 1948 elections, self-government and Malaysia. Dates and membershipchecked at the level of the institutional account; underlying Orders-in-Council not separately retrieved.
note.zh: 已读机构的宪制年表：海峡殖民地解散，新加坡成为单独的殖民地，槟城和马六甲并入马来亚联邦，1948 年有限选举，自治和马来西亚。日期和议员组成只核对到机构记述的层面；所依据的枢密院令没有另行取得。

text.en: NAS, Law of the Land: Constitutional Documents
text.zh: 新加坡国家档案馆《国土之法：宪制文件》

note.en: Read: Full institutional article and constitutional chronology. Distinguishes 1826 incorporation from Second Charter 27 November. Short evidence quotation: “a royal charter dated 27 November 1826”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：机构文章全文和宪制年表。文章区分 1826 年的合并与 11 月 27 日的第二份特许状。简短证据引文：“一份日期为 1826 年 11 月 27 日的皇家特许状”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Approved Singapore 1819–1965 content specification, docs/28, sections 1–2
text.zh: 已批准的《新加坡 1819–1965》内容规格，docs/28，第 1–2 节

note.en: Read the supplied specification in full. This entry identifies an authorised draft event or map anchor, not independent historical corroboration. Rows relying only on this source are individually listed in content-gaps.json and must not be treated as verified evidence. No unresolved casualty quantity is supplied from memory.
note.zh: 已读所提供的规格全文。本条只表示事件或地图锚点是经授权起草的，不是独立的历史佐证。只依靠本来源的条目已逐条列入缺口清单，不能当作经过核实的证据。没有凭记忆提供任何未确定的伤亡数字。

text.en: James Horsburgh, The India Directory, fifth edition, volume I (1841)
text.zh: James Horsburgh《印度航海指南》第五版第一卷（1841）

note.en: Read public-domain OCR of sailing directions and named port/cape descriptions: printed pp. 38–78, 105–155 (Atlantic/Cape/Indian Ocean), 280–291 (Hoogly), 300–389 (Red Sea, Aden and Maculla), 541–547 (Ceylon/Galle), 586–596 (Coromandel/Madras). Corridors interpret sailing directions and offshore berths, not individual vessel tracks; exact page groups per route in content-route-sources.md. Public domain by author death 1836 and publication date.
note.zh: 已读航海指南及港口、海角描述的公有领域 OCR 文本：印本第 38–78、105–155 页（大西洋、好望角、印度洋），280–291 页（胡格利河），300–389 页（红海、亚丁和穆卡拉），541–547 页（锡兰、加勒），586–596 页（科罗曼德尔、马德拉斯）。航道是对航海指南和近海锚地的解读，不是个别船只的航迹；每条航线对应的页码另有记录。作者 1836 年去世，加上出版年代，属于公有领域。

text.en: James Horsburgh, The India Directory, fifth edition, volume II (1843)
text.zh: James Horsburgh《印度航海指南》第五版第二卷（1843）

note.en: Read public-domain OCR: pp. 62–65 (Achen/Great Channel), 90–113 (Sumatra/Marlborough), 145–177 (Sunda/Banca), 201–204 (Rhio), 218–281 (Malacca and Singapore straits, St John’s and Pedra Branca), 334–340 (Cochin-China/Condore), 349–352 (Hainan), 390–394 (Hong Kong approaches), 413–429 (China coast/Amoy), 473–477 (Canton–Pulo Aor passages), 539–550 (Macassar), 588–590 (Lubeck/Babian/Bawean). Paths are schematic corridors following named passages; positions between named marks interpret the printed bearings and berths. Not sailing advice. Public domain.
note.zh: 已读公有领域 OCR 文本：第 62–65 页（亚齐、大海峡），90–113 页（苏门答腊、马尔伯勒），145–177 页（巽他、邦加），201–204 页（廖内），218–281 页（马六甲海峡和新加坡海峡、圣约翰岛和白礁），334–340 页（交趾支那、昆仑岛），349–352 页（海南），390–394 页（香港附近水域），413–429 页（中国沿海、厦门），473–477 页（广州至奥尔岛的航道），539–550 页（望加锡），588–590 页（Lubeck、Babian、巴韦安岛）。航线是沿着有名称的航道画出的示意走廊；有名称的标志之间的位置是对书中方位和锚地的解读。不是航海建议。公有领域。

text.en: Malaysia Agreement 1963, UNTS 750, no.I-10760, pp.2–8 and amendment p.241
text.zh: 《1963 年马来西亚协定》，《联合国条约集》第 750 卷，第 I-10760 号，第 2–8 页及第 241 页的修正

note.en: Read: Original UN treaty PDF read opening agreement and 28 August amendment: original 31 August, amended 16 September. Includes parties and 9 July London signature. Short evidence quotation: “Signed at London, on 9 July 1963”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：联合国条约 PDF 原件中协定的开头部分和 8 月 28 日的修正：原定 8 月 31 日，修正为 9 月 16 日。包括缔约各方和 7 月 9 日在伦敦签署。简短证据引文：“1963 年 7 月 9 日签于伦敦”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Lee Meiyu, Federation of Malaysia (NLB)
text.zh: Lee Meiyu《马来西亚联邦》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局）

note.en: Read: Full article, proposal, referendum, Coldstore, Konfrontasi, separation. Do not reproduce its apparent two-death MacDonald error; dedicated bombing article records three. Short evidence quotation: “On 20 January 1963, Indonesian Foreign Minister Subandrio”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，包括提议、全民投票、冷藏行动、印尼对抗和分家。不沿用文中关于麦唐纳大厦两人死亡的明显错误；专门的爆炸案文章记为三人。简短证据引文：“1963 年 1 月 20 日，印尼外交部长苏班德里约”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: H. Marriott, The Peoples of Singapore, in One Hundred Years of Singapore, volume I (1921), p.358
text.zh: H. Marriott《新加坡的各族人民》，载《新加坡百年》第一卷（1921），第 358 页

note.en: Read: Public-domain OCR table for 1871 read in full; preserve its historical categories, including convicts under Others. Short evidence quotation: “Grand Total”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：1871 年表格的公有领域 OCR 文本全文；保留当时的分类，包括列在“其他”之下的囚犯。简短证据引文：“总计”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: The Fruit of His Labour: David Marshall’s Old Apple Tree (NLB, 2016)
text.zh: 《劳动的果实：马绍尔的老苹果树》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局，2016）

note.en: Read: Full article, constitutional talks and resignation paragraph; separates security-council veto issue from self-government negotiations. Short evidence quotation: “Marshall resigned as Chief Minister on 7 June 1956”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，包括宪制谈判和辞职的段落；文章把安全理事会否决权问题和自治谈判分开讲。简短证据引文：“马绍尔于 1956 年 6 月 7 日辞去首席部长职务”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: NLB, Syed Omar Aljunied
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《Syed Omar Aljunied》

note.en: Read: Indexed biography text read: merchant/philanthropist, Masjid Omar, land for hospital/cemetery; grandson founded 1927 school. Direct response incomplete. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：被索引的传记文字：商人和慈善家，奥马回教堂（Masjid Omar），为医院和坟场捐地；他的孙子在 1927 年创办学校。直接获取的回应不完整。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Diana S. Kim, The Sticky Problem of Opium Revenue (NLB, 2020)
text.zh: Diana S. Kim《鸦片税收的棘手问题》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局，2020）

note.en: Read: Full article, especially Opium and Colonial State Building; notes 9–11. Kim 2020 book and Blue Book 1921 not separately read. Short evidence quotation: “opium accounted for over 50 percent of the revenue collected in the Straits Settlements”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，尤其是“鸦片与殖民国家的建立”一节；注 9–11。Kim 2020 年的著作和 1921 年的《蓝皮书》没有另行阅读。简短证据引文：“鸦片占海峡殖民地所收税收的 50% 以上”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Poh Soo Kai, 60 th Anniversary of the Formation of Barisan Sosialis (2021)
text.zh: 傅树介《社会主义阵线成立 60 周年》（2021）

note.en: Read: Participant retrospective statement read opening, 1956 account, 1959–63 section. Claims of suppression and illegitimate charges are attributed, not adjudicated. Formation 29 July 1961. Short evidence quotation: “formed on 29 July 1961”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：这位亲历者回顾声明的开头、1956 年的叙述和 1959–63 年一节。其中关于镇压和不正当指控的说法标明出处，不作裁断。成立于 1961 年 7 月 29 日。简短证据引文：“于 1961 年 7 月 29 日成立”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Lane J.Harris, Postal Networks and the Post Office Riots of 1876, IIAS Newsletter 63(Spring 2013), p.5
text.zh: Lane J. Harris《邮政网络与 1876 年邮政局暴动》，《国际亚洲研究所通讯》第 63 期（2013 年春季），第 5 页

note.en: Read: Full one-page article read; 15 December 1876 start 81 Market Street; 3 killed when police fired near Ellenborough Market. Contrasts official secret-society explanation and remittance/postal-network explanation. Short evidence quotation: “15 December 1876”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：一页文章全文；1876 年 12 月 15 日从马吉街 81 号开始；警察在 Ellenborough 巴刹附近开枪，3 人死亡。文章对比官方的私会党解释和侨汇／邮政网络的解释。简短证据引文：“1876 年 12 月 15 日”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Tan Cheng Bock v Attorney-General [2017] SGHC 160, paragraphs 8–10
text.zh: 陈清木诉总检察长案 [2017] SGHC 160，第 8–10 段

note.en: Read: Judgment paragraphs 8–10 read: Constitution(Amendment)Act 8/1965 passed 22 December, retrospective 9 August; incumbent deemed President under section 9. Short evidence quotation: “changed the title of the Yang di-Pertuan Negara of Singapore to that of the President of Singapore”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：判决书第 8–10 段：1965 年第 8 号《宪法（修正）法令》于 12 月 22 日通过，追溯至 8 月 9 日生效；根据第 9 条，在任者被视为总统。简短证据引文：“把新加坡元首（Yang di-Pertuan Negara）的称号改为新加坡总统”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Irene Lim, The Chinese Protectorate (NLB, updated 2021)
text.zh: Irene Lim《华民护卫司》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局，2021 年更新）

note.en: Read: Full article, establishment, first office North Canal Road, credit system, surveillance and prostitution regulation. Only year 1877 securely supported here. Short evidence quotation: “upon their arrival they had to pay for their passage and other expenses”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，包括设立、第一处办公室在北干拿路、赊欠制度、监视和对卖淫的管制。这里只有 1877 年这个年份有可靠依据。简短证据引文：“他们到达时必须支付船费和其他费用”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Singapore Elections, National Referendum 1962
text.zh: Singapore Elections 网站《1962 年全民投票》

note.en: Read: Full results table read. Private compilation, not government original. Shows electorate 619867, ballots 561559; keep denominator explicit. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：结果表全文。这是私人汇编，不是政府原件。表中选民 619,867 人，投出选票 561,559 张；分母必须写明。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: W. W. Rockhill, Notes on the Relations and Trade of China, Part II (1915), pp.129–133
text.zh: W. W. Rockhill《中国关系与贸易札记》第二部分（1915），第 129–133 页

note.en: Read: Complete public-domain Part II OCR downloaded. Read Singapore Strait/Lung-ya-men and Pan-tsu entries and footnotes. Rockhill suggested several alternatives; does not prove a precise modern point. Short evidence quotation: “This locality is the hill back of Lung-ya mén”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：下载第二部分的公有领域 OCR 全文，读了新加坡海峡／龙牙门和班卒的条目及脚注。Rockhill 提出了几种可能，不能证明是哪一个精确的现代地点。简短证据引文：“这个地方是龙牙门后面的山”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Kelvin E.Y. Low, Remembering the Samsui Women (UBCPress, 2014), introduction p.3
text.zh: Kelvin E. Y. Low《记忆三水妇女》（UBC 出版社，2014），导言第 3 页

note.en: Read: Publisher sample read pp.3–4, contemporary memories discussed later. Gives male arrivals 1929–31 and quotas from 1930; exact 1933 commencement conflicts with immigration departmental history. Short evidence quotation: “Quotas were imposed on Chinese male migrants beginning in 1930”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：出版社样章第 3–4 页，当代记忆在后文讨论。书中给出 1929–31 年男性入境人数和 1930 年起的配额；1933 年这一具体开始时间与移民部门的历史记述有出入。简短证据引文：“从 1930 年起对华人男性移民实行配额”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Saw Swee-Hock, The Population of Singapore, second edition (2007), pp.8–10 and 16–17
text.zh: 苏瑞福《新加坡人口》第二版（2007），第 8–10、16–17 页

note.en: Read: Publisher preview PDF downloaded and extracted. Table 2.1: 1871 96,087; 1931 557,745. Table 2.5: 1957 1,445,929. This is not the requested 2012 third edition. Short evidence quotation: “the population numbered 1,445,929”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：下载并提取出版社的预览 PDF。表 2.1：1871 年 96,087 人；1931 年 557,745 人。表 2.5：1957 年 1,445,929 人。这不是原先要找的 2012 年第三版。简短证据引文：“人口为 1,445,929 人”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Independence of Singapore Agreement, 7 August 1965, Articles I–II and signatures (Wikisource transcription)
text.zh: 《新加坡独立协定》（1965 年 8 月 7 日），第一、二条及签署（维基文库转录）

note.en: Read: Full treaty text read. Lists all 10 Singapore ministers with pre-separation portfolios. Transcription checked as text, original scan and SSO not independently opened. Short evidence quotation: “Done this 7th day of August, 1965”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：条约全文。列出全部 10 名新加坡部长及其分家前的职务。转录本只作为文字核对，原扫描件和新加坡法规在线没有另行打开。简短证据引文：“1965 年 8 月 7 日签订”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: DFAT, Cable 315, Critchley to Canberra, 16 August 1965
text.zh: 澳大利亚外交贸易部，第 315 号电报，Critchley 致堪培拉，1965 年 8 月 16 日

note.en: Read: Complete contemporary cable read; report of Malaysian ministers’ account, not omniscient evidence. First meeting 13 July corrected by later 24 August cable per NLB 2026. Short evidence quotation: “The Tunku said he reached his decision in hospital on June 29th”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：当时的电报全文；这是对马来西亚部长们说法的转述，不是全知的证据。据新加坡国家图书馆管理局 2026 年的文章，第一次会面在 7 月 13 日的说法已被后来 8 月 24 日的电报更正。简短证据引文：“东姑说，他是 6 月 29 日在医院里作出决定的”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Dewan Ra’ayat, Official Report, 9 August 1965, columns 1517–1522
text.zh: 马来西亚国会下议院议事录，1965 年 8 月 9 日，第 1517–1522 栏

note.en: Read: Downloaded original parliamentary scan; read second and third reading divisions, Razak’s closing speech and abstention list. Visually inspected PDF page 38 (columns 1519–1520). Both divisions record 126 ayes, zero noes and one abstention. Short evidence quotation: “Ayes, 126; Noes, Nil; Abstentions, 1.”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：下载议事录扫描原件，读了二读和三读的表决、拉萨的总结发言和弃权名单，目视查看 PDF 第 38 页（第 1519–1520 栏）。两次表决都是 126 票赞成、0 票反对、1 票弃权。简短证据引文：“赞成 126；反对无；弃权 1。”适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Singapore Improvement Trust, Annual Reports 1955–1959: 1955 p.5 and 1959 p.ix
text.zh: 新加坡改良信托局《1955–1959 年年报》：1955 年第 5 页和 1959 年第 ix 页

note.en: Read: Downloaded 23 MB original government report scan and read census tables on PDF pages 22,330 and 418; visually checked page 418. Confirms 1931 groups; 1957 groups differ slightly from the later UN return. Reason for revision not established. Short evidence quotation: “FACTS AND FIGURES ABOUT SINGAPORE”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：下载 23 MB 的政府报告原扫描件，读了 PDF 第 22、330 和 418 页的人口普查表，目视核对第 418 页。确认 1931 年各族群数字；1957 年各族群数字与后来联合国报告稍有不同。修订的原因没有查明。简短证据引文：“关于新加坡的事实与数字”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: NHB, Street Names in Singapore
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局《新加坡街名》

note.en: Read: Indexed article body read; direct page empty. Coleman, Pickering, Syed Alwi entries provisional pending page/primary check. Syed Alwi is Aljunied, not Alsagoff. Short evidence quotation: “Syed Allie Bin Mohamed AlJunied”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：被索引的正文；直接打开页面是空的。哥里门、毕麒麟、Syed Alwi 三条暂定，有待核对页面或原始资料。Syed Alwi 属于 Aljunied 家族，不是 Alsagoff 家族。简短证据引文：“Syed Allie Bin Mohamed AlJunied”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Prominent People and Their Street Names (NLB Biblio Asia, 2009)
text.zh: 《名人与以他们命名的街道》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》，2009）

note.en: Read: Full article read, Tan Kim Seng, Eu Tong Sen and Tan Jiak Kim street entries. Eponym and philanthropy separately recorded. Short evidence quotation: “Eu Tong Sen Street”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：全文，包括陈金声、余东旋和陈若锦的街道条目。以人名命名街道和慈善事迹分开记录。简短证据引文：“余东旋街”。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Treaty between UK and Siam, 10 March 1909, printed p.1034
text.zh: 《英国与暹罗条约》（1909 年 3 月 10 日），印本第 1034 页

note.en: Read: Validated page transcription read header and Articles 1–3; ratification 9 July distinct from signing 10 March. Short evidence quotation: “Ratifications exchanged at London, July 9, 1909.”. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：经过核对的页面转录，包括标题和第 1–3 条；7 月 9 日交换批准书与 3 月 10 日签署是两回事。简短证据引文：“1909 年 7 月 9 日在伦敦交换批准书。”适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: United Nations Legislative Series, 1957 Legislative Yearbook, p.287
text.zh: 联合国立法丛书，《1957 年立法年鉴》，第 287 页

note.en: Read: Only indexed legislation metadata was read; the original PDF was not obtained. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：只读了被索引的立法元数据；没有取得原 PDF。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Singapore Free Press, 6 April 1927 issue, Kreta Ayerinquest reporting
text.zh: 《新加坡自由西报》1927 年 4 月 6 日，牛车水死因研讯的报道

note.en: Read: The newspaper issue index was read; individual inquest articles were not opened. The original newspaper narrative remains unread. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：读了这期报纸的索引；没有打开各篇研讯报道。报纸原来的叙述仍未阅读。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: P.A.Leupe, De Stichting van Singapore, BKI 54(1902), pp.362 ff
text.zh: P. A. Leupe《新加坡的建立》（De Stichting van Singapore），《BKI》第 54 卷（1902），第 362 页起

note.en: Read: Only indexed excerpt of 9 April 1825 Dutch proclamation seen; full PDF not read. Scope and open differences: RESEARCH.md.
note.zh: 已读：只看到 1825 年 4 月 9 日荷兰公告被索引的摘录；没有读 PDF 全文。适用范围和尚未解决的出入另见研究记录。

text.en: Contains information from URA Master Plan 2019 Planning Area Boundary (No Sea) accessed on 17 October 2026 from data.gov.sg which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence).
text.zh: 含有市区重建局《2019 年总蓝图规划区边界（不含海域）》的资料，2026 年 10 月 17 日取自 data.gov.sg，依据新加坡开放数据许可第 1.0 版提供。

note.en: Read: Dataset metadata and downloaded GeoJSON; current land is the reconstruction baseline, never a historical shoreline by itself. Download, SHA-256, historical map traces and outstanding accuracy gates are recorded in SOURCES-GEO.md.
note.zh: 已读：数据集元数据和下载的 GeoJSON；现在的陆地是重建的基准，本身绝不代表历史海岸线。下载记录、校验值、历史地图描摹和尚待通过的精度检验另见地理来源记录。

text.en: Natural Earth, 1:10m admin-1, admin-0 and land datasets; public domain.
text.zh: Natural Earth 1:10m 一级行政区、国家和陆地数据集；公有领域。

note.en: Read: Official terms of use and downloaded feature properties. Modern administrative units provide approximate regional units; they do not establish nineteenth-century boundaries. No modern outline silently resolves Dindings or Lawas.
note.zh: 已读：官方使用条款和下载的要素属性。现代行政单位只提供大致的地区单位，不能确定十九世纪的边界。没有用任何现代轮廓不加说明地解决天定或老越的问题。

text.en: Federation of Malaya Order in Council 1948, SI 1948/108, sections 2–4 and Second Schedule
text.zh: 《1948 年马来亚联合邦枢密院令》，SI 1948/108，第 2–4 条及附表二

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Directly read the original 109-page PDF through the web reader: printed pp. 1231–1234, 1276–1277 (PDF pages 1–4, 46–47). Section 3 makes both the Order and State/Federation Agreements effective on 1 February 1948. The Second Schedule reproduces the agreement dated 21 January. Initial direct downloads returned empty or timed out; later web access successfully supplied the original PDF text. The complete instrument was not read. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：通过网页阅读器直接读了 109 页的 PDF 原件：印本第 1231–1234、1276–1277 页（PDF 第 1–4、46–47 页）。第 3 条规定本令和各州／联合邦协定都于 1948 年 2 月 1 日生效。附表二转载了日期为 1 月 21 日的协定。最初直接下载得到空文件或超时；后来通过网页访问成功取得 PDF 原文。没有读完整份文件。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Majlis Dato Lembaga Adat Sungei Ujong, Dato Undang Yang Empat Sama Berdaulat Dengan Raja-Raja Melayu Tubuhkan Persekutuan Tanah Melayu
text.zh: 双溪乌绒拿督习俗长老理事会《四位拿督 Undang 与马来统治者同享主权，共同成立马来亚联合邦》

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the full institutional account and list of signatories. It distinguishes agreement on 21 January from effect on 1 February 1948; the British legal instrument independently confirms the latter. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了机构记述全文和签署人名单。它区分 1 月 21 日达成协定和 1948 年 2 月 1 日生效；英国的法律文件独立确认了后者。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: UMNO Online, Penubuhan UMNO
text.zh: 巫统网站《巫统的成立》

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the complete official party history page in Malay. It dates the third Malay Congress/first UMNO general assembly and adoption of its constitution to 11 May 1946 at Istana Besar, Johor Bahru. This is the party’s institutional account, not the original 1946 constitution. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了马来文官方党史页面全文。它把第三届马来人大会暨巫统第一届代表大会以及党章的通过定在 1946 年 5 月 11 日，地点在新山的柔佛大皇宫（Istana Besar）。这是党的机构记述，不是 1946 年党章原件。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: UK House of Lords, Brunei, 20 December 1962, vol. 245, cols. 1262–1266
text.zh: 英国议会议事录（上议院），《文莱》，1962 年 12 月 20 日，第 245 卷第 1262–1266 栏

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the complete contemporary statement and questions. Col. 1263 dates violence to 2 a.m. on 8 December and describes North Borneo police and British forces from Singapore. Its losses are provisional British government reports, not a final reconciliation. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了当时的声明和质询全文。第 1263 栏把暴力事件定在 12 月 8 日凌晨 2 时，并提到北婆罗洲警察和从新加坡派出的英国部队。其中的损失数字是英国政府的初步报告，不是最终核实的数字。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: UK House of Lords, Rising in Brunei, 10 December 1962, vol. 245, cols. 415–419
text.zh: 英国议会议事录（上议院），《文莱起事》，1962 年 12 月 10 日，第 245 卷第 415–419 栏

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the complete contemporary statement and questions. The minister identifies the North Kalimantan National Army, attacks on Brunei police/government buildings, the Sultan’s request for British help, British Army/Royal Marines/naval/air units and police from Sarawak/North Borneo. This is one government’s contemporaneous account; allegations about Azahari’s claims and plans must stay attributed. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了当时的声明和质询全文。大臣提到北加里曼丹国民军、对文莱警察和政府建筑的攻击、苏丹请求英国援助、英国陆军／皇家海军陆战队／海军和空军部队，以及来自砂拉越和北婆罗洲的警察。这是一国政府当时的说法；关于阿扎哈里（Azahari）的主张和计划的指控必须标明出处。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: National Archives of Singapore, All Must Vote, 1959 (9 September 2015)
text.zh: 新加坡国家档案馆《人人必须投票，1959》（2015 年 9 月 9 日）

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the full institutional article. It explicitly dates the first Cabinet’s swearing-in to 5 June 1959 and the election to 30 May. It is not the original appointment instrument or oath text. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了机构文章全文。文章明确写第一届内阁于 1959 年 6 月 5 日宣誓就职，大选在 5 月 30 日。它不是任命文件原件，也不是誓词原文。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: NAS photograph B0033/30, Swearing-in of PAP Government at City Hall
text.zh: 新加坡国家档案馆照片 B0033/30《人民行动党政府在政府大厦宣誓就职》

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the complete original photograph catalog metadata: covering date 05/06/1959, negative B0033/30, Ministry of Information and the Arts Collection. Its description identifies Lee and Cabinet ministers after the ceremony. Catalog metadata corroborates the institutional date; the oath document itself was not read. Photo reproduction requires permission and is not proposed here. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了照片原始目录元数据全文：日期 1959 年 6 月 5 日，底片 B0033/30，新闻及艺术部收藏。说明指出照片中是典礼后的李光耀和内阁部长。目录元数据佐证了机构文章的日期；宣誓文件本身没有阅读。复制照片需要许可，这里不打算使用。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: National Heritage Board, Kampong Glam Heritage Trail, printed pp. 4–5 and 38–39
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局《甘榜格南文物径》，印本第 4–5 页和第 38–39 页

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Downloaded the complete 4.96 MB official trail PDF. Read and visually inspected PDF pages 4 and 21 (printed pp. 4–5 and 38–39). The original mosque was constructed 1824–1826; the first timber Istana was completed in 1819, while Tunku Ali returned in 1840 and commissioned the current building. These are historical institutional summaries, not construction contracts. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：下载 4.96 MB 的官方文物径 PDF 全文，阅读并目视查看 PDF 第 4 页和第 21 页（印本第 4–5 页和第 38–39 页）。原来的回教堂建于 1824–1826 年；第一座木结构皇宫于 1819 年建成，东姑阿里 1840 年回来后下令建造现在的建筑。这些是机构的历史概述，不是建筑合同。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Official Penang State Courts portal, Sejarah Mahkamah Pulau Pinang
text.zh: 槟城州法院官方网站《槟城法院历史》

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the historical section in full, particularly its opening paragraph and the Butterworth section. It explicitly places British taking of Prince of Wales Island on 11 August 1786. This dates EIC possession, not the first human settlement of Penang. The original Francis Light journal was not read. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：完整读了历史部分，尤其是开头一段和北海一节。它明确把英国取得威尔斯亲王岛定在 1786 年 8 月 11 日。这是东印度公司占有的日期，不是槟城最早有人定居的日期。莱特（Francis Light）的日记原件没有阅读。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Penang State Government, Sejarah, attributed to Lembaga Muzium Pulau Pinang
text.zh: 槟城州政府《历史》，出自槟城博物馆局

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the full Malay historical page. It dates British arrival to 1786 and explicitly records earlier habitation and Malay settlements. Used to prevent a British-possession date being presented as the origin of settlement. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了马来文历史页面全文。它把英国人到达定在 1786 年，并明确记录此前已有人居住和马来人聚落。用来避免把英国占有的日期说成定居的起点。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Census of Population and Agriculture (Consolidation) Orders, O 1, Revised Edition 1990 (25 March 1992), table (a)
text.zh: 《人口与农业普查（汇编）令》，O 1，1990 年修订版（1992 年 3 月 25 日），表（a）

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the complete indexed legal order table returned by search, including the 1931 row (1 April 1931; G.N. 1956/30; 26 September 1930) and 1957 row. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403; do not claim a directly inspected original Gazette scan. A separate contemporary annual report’s reproduced text corroborates the distinction between reference night and enumeration. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了搜索返回的被索引法令表格全文，包括 1931 年一行（1931 年 4 月 1 日；宪报公告 G.N. 1956/30；1930 年 9 月 26 日）和 1957 年一行。直接获取页面被拒绝；不能声称直接查看过宪报扫描原件。另一份同时代年报转载的文字佐证了普查基准夜和点查之间的区别。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Straits Settlements Annual Report for 1931, Colonial Reports Annual no. 1599 (HMSO, 1932), printed p. 5; reproduced text
text.zh: 《海峡殖民地 1931 年年报》，殖民地年度报告第 1599 号（英国皇家文书局，1932），印本第 5 页；转载文本

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the reproduced original report text, title/contents and printed pp. 1–6, especially the opening of Chapter III on p. 5. It states enumeration on 2 April 1931 as at midnight the previous night. This is directly read primary-report OCR/reproduced text on Scribd, not a downloaded or visually checked original scan. Do not transcribe its garbled community table. The official SSO indexed order independently states the reference night of 1 April. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：读了转载的报告原文、标题／目录和印本第 1–6 页，尤其是第 5 页第三章的开头。其中写明点查在 1931 年 4 月 2 日进行，以前一晚午夜为准。这是在 Scribd 上直接读到的原始报告 OCR／转载文本，不是下载或目视核对过的原扫描件。不要转录其中错乱的族群表。新加坡法规在线被索引的法令独立写明基准夜为 4 月 1 日。证据引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。

text.en: Kwa Chong Guan, Remembering John Norman Miksic (NLB, 1 January 2026)
text.zh: 柯宗元《怀念 John Norman Miksic》（新加坡国家图书馆管理局，2026 年 1 月 1 日）

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read the full institutional article. Its investigation paragraph dates the first Fort Canning dig from 18 to 28 January 1984 and reports pottery finds. This closes the 1984 start at institutional level; the 1985 original field report remains unread. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Read original scholarly PDF pp. 206–209, particularly p. 208 and notes 35–36. Distinguishes Indian Immigrants’ Protection Ordinance No. 1 of 1876, suspension in Singapore/Malacca under No. 5 of 1876 until 1883, and replacement No. 4 of 1884. It points to Gazette G.N. 577 of 28 December 1883. This resolves why several years coexist but does not substitute for reading the original ordinance and commencement notification. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Downloaded the complete 113-page, 3.98 MB official decision copy. Its own text records an earlier defensive base in 1782–1784, so 1803 is not first habitation. Evidence quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json and RESEARCH.md; this note adds no further quotation.

text.en: British Military Administration, Malaya, Proclamation No. 1, signed 15 August 1945; reproduced in Singapore ICJ Memorial Annex 84, p. 743
text.zh: 英国军政府（马来亚）第 1 号公告，1945 年 8 月 15 日签署；转载于新加坡向国际法院提交的诉状附件 84，第 743 页

note.en: Read by the topic research agent: Downloaded the complete 13,084,375-byte, 221-page ICJ annex volume. Read OCR and visually inspected PDF page 143, Annex 84 p. 743: original Gazette reproduction of Proclamation No. 1, signed at Kandy on 15 August 1945, published in the Malay Peninsula Gazette no. 1 of 1 November 1945. Read all eight clauses. Clause 1 establishes BMA in areas of Malaya under forces’ control at any given time; clause 2 similarly conditions jurisdiction. Thus signing, publication, local military control and the 12 September surrender ceremony are distinct milestones. Do not infer Singapore control on 15 August. The short quotation is recorded in research/date-closures.json; this note adds no further quotation. This confirms the proclamation signature, not a date of island-wide military control.
note.zh: 由主题研究代理阅读：下载完整的国际法院附件卷（13,084,375 字节，221 页），读了 OCR 文本并目视查看 PDF 第 143 页，即附件 84 第 743 页：宪报原件转载的第 1 号公告，1945 年 8 月 15 日在康提签署，刊登于 1945 年 11 月 1 日《马来半岛宪报》第 1 期。读了全部八条。第 1 条规定在任何时候处于军队控制下的马来亚地区设立英国军政府；第 2 条对管辖权也设了同样的条件。因此签署、刊登、当地实际军事控制和 9 月 12 日投降仪式是不同的节点。不要推断新加坡在 8 月 15 日已受控制。简短引文另见研究记录，本说明不再引用。这确认的是公告的签署，不是全岛军事控制的日期。

text.en: NLB, Bukit Larangan: Early Singapore in Maps, Texts, and Artifacts
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《禁山（Bukit Larangan）：地图、文献和文物里的早期新加坡》

note.en: Read the Singapore Stone passage and its description of the 1825 map: original Rocky Point location near present Fullerton. This supports a vicinity reference; the present hotel coordinate does not survey the destroyed boulder.
note.zh: 读了关于新加坡石的段落及其对 1825 年地图的描述：石头原来位于岩角（Rocky Point），靠近今天的富丽敦。这支持的是附近一带的参考位置；现在酒店的坐标不是对已被毁的巨石的测量。

text.en: National Heritage Board, The Padang
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局《大草场》

note.en: Read the institutional passage locating the open space of the Temenggong's house at today's Arts House vicinity, and its qualified association with negotiations. The source says may; no exact treaty location is asserted.
note.zh: 读了机构记述中的段落：天猛公宅邸前的空地位于今天艺术之家一带，以及它与谈判之间带保留的关联。来源用的是“可能”；没有断定条约签订的确切地点。

text.en: NLB, On Paper exhibition guide, Singapura/Singapore: 1819–1824
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《纸上》展览指南，“新加坡拉／新加坡：1819–1824”

note.en: Read the treaty-location qualification in the institutional guide. The guide states that the important treaties' locations remain unknown. This is the reason a locality reference remains approximate rather than receiving an invented signing-building position.
note.zh: 读了机构指南中关于条约地点的保留说法。指南说重要条约的签订地点至今不明。正因如此，这一带的参考位置保持为大致位置，而不是编造一个签约建筑的位置。

text.en: NParks, Dragon's Teeth Gate at Labrador Nature Reserve
text.zh: 国家公园局，拉布拉多自然保护区的龙牙门

note.en: Read the heritage feature account: Keppel western entrance, removal in 1848 and symbolic replica installed in 2005. Used to distinguish the documented present reference and interpretive medieval site from surviving original rock.
note.zh: 读了文物景点的介绍：吉宝港西口，1848 年被移除，2005 年安放象征性的复制品。用来把有据可查的现今参考点、作为解读的中世纪地点，与留存至今的原始岩石区分开。

text.en: Timothy Pwee, Singapore's First School, NLB BiblioAsia (2016)
text.zh: Timothy Pwee《新加坡第一所学校》，新加坡国家图书馆管理局《BiblioAsia》（2016）

note.en: Read the old-campus passage identifying the Bras Basah premises with today's Raffles City. The current complex is used as a reference point for the former site, not as a surviving school footprint or an exact foundation-stone location.
note.zh: 读了关于旧校舍的段落，其中指出勿拉士峇沙的校址就是今天的莱佛士城。现在的建筑群只作为旧址的参考点，不是留存的学校范围，也不是奠基石的确切位置。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Alexandra Road: Alexandra Barracks
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《亚历山大路：亚历山大兵营》

note.en: Read the barracks passage identifying the 5th Light Infantry's Alexandra Barracks near Alexandra Road. The source also dates Gillman Barracks to 1936, so that later compound is not substituted for the 1915 site. The district reference remains approximate.
note.zh: 读了关于兵营的段落，其中指出第五轻步兵团的亚历山大兵营在亚历山大路附近。来源也把吉尔曼兵营定在 1936 年，所以不用这座后来的营区代替 1915 年的地点。这一带的参考位置仍是大致位置。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Outram Prison (Pearl's Hill Prison)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《欧南监狱（珍珠山监狱）》

note.en: Read punishment and executions passage: 1915 public firing-squad executions outside prison gates. The current former-prison reference does not establish exact gate alignment or individual execution positions.
note.zh: 读了关于刑罚和处决的段落：1915 年在监狱大门外公开枪决。现在的旧监狱参考点不能确定大门的确切方位，也不能确定每次处决的位置。

text.en: NHB, Little India Heritage Trail booklet, Becoming Little India
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局《小印度文物径》手册，“成为小印度”

note.en: Read the district-core passage returned from the official booklet: the pre-tourist Little India core at Serangoon comprised the Kandang Kerbau area centred on Tekka Market. Today's Tekka coordinate is an explicitly approximate district-centre reference; it does not date the present building to 1823.
note.zh: 读了官方手册中关于地区核心的段落：旅游业兴起之前，实龙岗一带的小印度核心是以竹脚巴刹为中心的 Kandang Kerbau（竹脚）地区。今天竹脚的坐标明确只是大致的地区中心参考，不表示现在的建筑建于 1823 年。

text.en: NHB, Jubilee Walk booklet, National Gallery Singapore, printed p.44
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局《金禧步道》手册，新加坡国家美术馆，印本第 44 页

note.en: Read the City Hall heritage entry, printed p.44: 3 June 1959 self-government rally on the steps, the first cabinet's 1959 oath in the Chamber, and the 1965 Proclamation issued from Lee's City Hall office. It distinguishes those events; a current building coordinate does not establish an exact platform, desk or broadcast studio.
note.zh: 读了印本第 44 页关于政府大厦的文物条目：1959 年 6 月 3 日在台阶上举行自治集会，1959 年第一届内阁在议事厅宣誓，1965 年的宣言从李光耀在政府大厦的办公室发出。条目把这些事件区分开；现在建筑的坐标不能确定确切的讲台、办公桌或广播室。

text.en: Official Journal of the French Empire, 29 November 1869, no. 328 p. 1527, reproduced/translated by Fondation Napoléon
text.zh: 《法兰西帝国官方公报》1869 年 11 月 29 日第 328 期第 1527 页，拿破仑基金会转载并翻译

note.en: Read the ceremony passage: Port Said was prepared for the canal blessing; official platforms were on the opposite bank from the quay. This confirms Port Said as the opening locality but provides no surveyed platform coordinate.
note.zh: 读了关于典礼的段落：塞得港为运河祝福仪式做了准备；官方看台设在码头对岸。这确认塞得港是通航地点，但没有提供经过测量的看台坐标。

text.en: Wartime Victuals: Surviving the Japanese Occupation, BiblioAsia, April–June 2019
text.zh: 《战时饮食：在日据时期活下来》，《BiblioAsia》2019 年 4–6 月

note.en: Read the resettlement section and caption: farming communities were established in Endau, Johor, and Bahau, Negeri Sembilan; the Chinese settlement in Endau is identified. No exact surveyed settlement footprint is supplied.
note.zh: 读了关于移民垦殖的一节和图片说明：在柔佛兴楼和森美兰马口建立了农业社区；文中指出兴楼是华人的垦殖区。没有提供经过测量的垦殖区范围。

note.en: Read introductory paragraphs and Declaration of emergency: the murders near Sungei Siput, Perak, on 16 June 1948 precipitated declarations in Perak/Johor, the Federation and Singapore. The locality is source-backed; exact plantation sites are not asserted.
note.zh: 读了开头几段和“宣布紧急状态”一节：1948 年 6 月 16 日霹雳和丰附近的谋杀事件，促使霹雳和柔佛、马来亚联合邦以及新加坡先后宣布紧急状态。地点有来源支持；没有断定种植园的确切位置。

text.en: Arkib Negara Malaysia, Pengisytiharan Kemerdekaan Tanah Melayu
text.zh: 马来西亚国家档案馆《马来亚宣布独立》

note.en: Read the full institutional account: the proclamation ceremony on the morning of 31 August 1957 took place at Stadium Merdeka. This distinguishes the stadium from the earlier midnight flag ceremony at Padang Kelab Selangor.
note.zh: 读了机构记述全文：1957 年 8 月 31 日上午的独立宣告仪式在独立体育场（Stadium Merdeka）举行。这把体育场与此前午夜在雪兰莪俱乐部草场举行的升旗仪式区分开。

text.en: Arkib Negara Malaysia, Penubuhan Malaysia 16 September 1963
text.zh: 马来西亚国家档案馆《1963 年 9 月 16 日马来西亚成立》

note.en: Read the institutional proclamation account and chronology: the Malaysia proclamation ceremony was held at Stadium Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, on 16 September 1963. Separate July treaty signature occurred at Marlborough House, London.
note.zh: 读了机构关于宣告的记述和年表：马来西亚成立宣告仪式于 1963 年 9 月 16 日在吉隆坡独立体育场举行。7 月的条约签署是另一回事，在伦敦马尔伯勒宫举行。

text.en: Singapore Law Gazette, Two Centuries of British Rule of Law: A Look Back to 1819
text.zh: 《新加坡法律公报》《英国法治两百年：回望 1819 年》

note.en: Read the Singapore as Sovereign? section: Tunku Long arrived in Singapore from Pulau Penyengat off Bintan after being summoned. This is a retrospective historical account, not an original 1819 departure record. NLB S6 separately confirms arrival from Riau; existing S257 already records this island coordinate.
note.zh: 读了“新加坡是主权国家？”一节：东姑隆应召从民丹岛外的 Penyengat 岛来到新加坡。这是事后的历史记述，不是 1819 年出发的原始记录。新加坡国家图书馆管理局 S6 另外确认他从廖内到达；已有的 S257 已记录这个岛的坐标。

note.en: Read article body through Closure: the later hotel occupied 1 and 2 Coleman Street at North Bridge Road; the hotel closed in 1973 and the present Adelphi Complex was built on the same site. This distinguishes that site from the earlier 3 Coleman Street hotel address.
