note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Page text extracted. The Marshall page: he “resigned and stepped down as chief minister on 7 June 1956”; the Labour Front page (cmsuuid 23259a06-ceef-4ff0-b454-335a367fcb57): “On 6 June 1956, Marshall resigned.” Both dates are kept.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。提取网页全文。马绍尔条目说他“1956 年 6 月 7 日辞职，卸下首席部长职务”；劳工阵线条目说“1956 年 6 月 6 日马绍尔辞职”。两个日期都保留。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, 1819 Singapore Treaty (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《1819 年新加坡条约》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. Citing Turnbull, about 1,000 inhabitants in 1819: “500 Orang Kallang, 200 Orang Seletar, 150 Orang Gelam and other orang laut”, about 20 to 30 Malays in the Temenggong's following and about as many Chinese; payments of 5,000 and 3,000 Spanish dollars a year.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。引 Turnbull 说 1819 年约有 1,000 名居民：“500 名加冷海人、200 名实里达海人、150 名格南海人及其他海人”，天猛公的随从中约有 20 至 30 名马来人，华人人数相近；每年付 5,000 和 3,000 西班牙银元。

text.en: BiblioAsia, Chasing the Dragon: opium in Singapore (vol. 11 no. 3, 2015)
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》《追龙：鸦片在新加坡》（第 11 卷第 3 期，2015）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. Opium “contributed about 40 to 60 percent of the government's annual revenue”; the Chandu Revenue Ordinance of 1909 ended the farms and a Monopolies Department was formed in 1910; opium-smoking was banned on 10 November 1943 under the Japanese, and the returning British banned it again in 1946.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。鸦片“占政府每年收入的约 40% 至 60%”；1909 年的鸦片税收法令结束饷码，1910 年成立专卖局；日据时期 1943 年 11 月 10 日禁止吸鸦片，英国人回来后在 1946 年再次禁止。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Hokkien–Teochew riots of 1854 (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《1854 年福建帮与潮州帮械斗》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. Began on 5 May 1854 and “lasted for at least 10 days”; about 500 dead and some 300 homes destroyed; about 500 arrested, six sentenced to death, two executed; the Temenggong sent 200 Malay men to help.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。1854 年 5 月 5 日开始，“持续至少 10 天”；约 500 人死亡，约 300 间房屋被毁；约 500 人被捕，6 人被判死刑，2 人被处决；天猛公派出 200 名马来人协助。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, William Pickering (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《毕麒麟》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. Pickering was “appointed the first Protector of Chinese on 3 May 1877”; the first office was a shophouse on North Canal Road.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。毕麒麟“在 1877 年 5 月 3 日被任命为第一任华民护卫司”；第一间办事处是北运河路的一间店屋。

text.en: National Heritage Board, collection record of the execution of mutineers at Outram Prison, 25 March 1915
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局藏品记录：1915 年 3 月 25 日欧南监狱外处决兵变者

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. “The execution took place on 25 March 1915 at Outram Prison”: 22 mutineers shot by a firing squad of 110 men of the Singapore Volunteer Corps.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。“处决于 1915 年 3 月 25 日在欧南监狱进行”：新加坡志愿军 110 人组成的行刑队枪决 22 名兵变者。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Kreta Ayer incident (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《牛车水事件》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. “On 12 March 1927”, at a memorial on Sun Yat-sen's second death anniversary, “the police fired into the crowd, killing six people”; 14 were injured.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。“1927 年 3 月 12 日”，在孙中山逝世两周年的纪念会上，“警察向人群开枪，打死 6 人”；14 人受伤。

text.en: Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre, Culturepaedia: Singapore's ancient names
text.zh: 新加坡华族文化中心 Culturepaedia《新加坡的古名》

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. The Nagarakretagama of 1365 by Mpu Prapanca records “Tumasik” as a subordinate state of Majapahit.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。1365 年普拉潘扎所作的《爪哇史颂》把“淡马锡”记为满者伯夷的属地。

text.en: BiblioAsia, Sang Nila Utama and the founding of Singapura (vol. 16 no. 2, 2020)
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》《山尼拉乌他玛与新加坡拉的建立》（第 16 卷第 2 期，2020）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. In Tomé Pires's Suma Oriental (c. 1513) Parameswara “was welcomed by the local ruler there. Parameswara then murdered the ruler and usurped his throne”; “around 1299” is a later reconstruction.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。托梅·皮列士《东方志》（约 1513 年）说拜里米苏拉“受到当地统治者欢迎，随后杀了统治者，夺了王位”；“1299 年前后”是后人推算的。

text.en: BiblioAsia, Dragon's Tooth Strait (vol. 10 no. 3, 2014)
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》《龙牙门》（第 10 卷第 3 期，2014）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. Wang Dayuan's account was first published in 1349 as an appendix and republished in 1350 as Daoyi zhilüe; it describes Longyamen and Banzu, which the article places on Fort Canning Hill.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。汪大渊的记载 1349 年先作为附录出版，1350 年以《岛夷志略》再版；书中写到龙牙门和班卒，文章认为班卒在福康宁山。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Singapore Mutiny (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《新加坡兵变》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. 15 February 1915; suppressed by “the police, the Singapore Volunteer Corps, military men brought in by the Sultan of Johor, a naval force from HMS Cadmus as well as sailors from Japanese, French and Russian naval ships”; “A total of 47 mutineers were executed”, before “a large crowd of 15,000 on one occasion”; 56 sepoys were killed. Its sentence on the dead can be read as 44 or 49 in all.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。1915 年 2 月 15 日；镇压兵变的有“警察、新加坡志愿军、柔佛苏丹派来的军人、英舰卡德摩斯号的海军，以及日本、法国和俄国军舰的水兵”；“共有 47 名兵变者被处决”，“有一次围观者多达 15,000 人”；56 名印度兵被打死。文中关于死者的句子，可以读成共 44 人，也可以读成 49 人。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Sultan Hussein Shah (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《苏丹胡先沙》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. Sultan Mahmud died on 14 January 1811 at Lingga; Abdul Rahman's accession “was supported by the Bugis viceroy in Lingga”; Hussein received $1,500 a month from 1823. It gives the 1824 lump sum as $32,000, against $33,200 in the treaty text printed by Buckley.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。苏丹马末 1811 年 1 月 14 日在林加去世；阿都拉曼继位“得到林加武吉斯副王的支持”；胡先 1823 年起每月领 1,500 元。文中 1824 年的一次性款项写作 32,000 元，巴克利刊印的条约原文是 33,200 元。

text.en: Virginia Matheson, “Mahmud, Sultan of Riau and Lingga (1823–1864)”, Indonesia 13 (Cornell, 1972)
text.zh: Virginia Matheson《廖内与林加苏丹马末（1823–1864）》，《印度尼西亚》第 13 期（康奈尔大学，1972）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. Genealogy gives Sultan Mahmud III as 1761–1812; Abdul Rahman's regalia “was restored to him in a formal installation ceremony in November 1823”.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。世系表写苏丹马末沙三世生卒为 1761–1812 年；阿都拉曼的王室信物“在 1823 年 11 月的正式登基典礼上归还给他”。

text.en: New Mandala, Herstory between borders: Engku Puteri Hamidah
text.zh: New Mandala《边界之间的她的故事：恩古·布特丽·哈米达》

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. Engku Puteri “would not surrender the regalia, so colonial troops took them by force” (Dutch troops, 1822).
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。恩古·布特丽“不肯交出王室信物，殖民地军队便强行夺走”（荷兰军队，1822 年）。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Sepoys (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《印度兵》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. Raffles's and Farquhar's party in 1819 “included 120 sepoys from the Bengal Native Infantry”; 200 more Indian troops came later from Penang.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。1819 年莱佛士和法夸尔一行“包括 120 名孟加拉土著步兵团的印度兵”；后来又有 200 名印度士兵从槟城调来。

text.en: BiblioAsia, Mother Island: Pulau Lingga (vol. 17 no. 4, 2022)
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》《母亲之岛：林加岛》（第 17 卷第 4 期，2022）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. “Mahmud Shah III (r. 1770–1811)”; “His death in 1811”; Abdul Rahman reigned 1811–32.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。“马末沙三世（1770–1811 年在位）”；“他在 1811 年去世”；阿都拉曼 1811 年至 1832 年在位。

text.en: Report of the Commission of Enquiry, North Borneo and Sarawak (Cobbold Commission), 1962, chapter 3, paragraph 144
text.zh: 《北婆罗洲与砂拉越调查委员会报告书》（科博德委员会，1962），第 3 章第 144 段

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Paragraph 144 read as quoted on the linked page (from the Wikisource text): “About one-third of the population of each territory strongly favours early realisation of Malaysia”; another third asks for conditions and safeguards; the remaining third is divided between those who insist on independence first and those who prefer continued British rule. The full report was not read.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取链接页面引用的第 144 段（出自维基文库本）：“两地各约三分之一的人口大力支持尽早成立马来西亚”；另三分之一要求条件与保障；其余三分之一分为坚持先独立和希望英国继续统治两派。报告全文没有读。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Indian convicts (archived copy)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《印度罪犯》（存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. “79 men and 1 woman from Madras – on 18 April 1825”, a second group of 122 from Bengal a week later; “nearly 3,000 convicts” in early 1857; works included roads, the brick Sri Mariamman temple (1843), St Andrew's and Cavenagh Bridge; transportation to Singapore ended in 1873.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。“1825 年 4 月 18 日，来自马德拉斯的 79 名男犯和 1 名女犯”，一周后又有 122 名来自孟加拉；1857 年初“将近 3,000 名罪犯”；修建了道路、砖造的马里安曼兴都庙（1843 年）、圣安德烈教堂和加文纳桥；1873 年不再向新加坡押送罪犯。

text.en: National Heritage Board, collection record on the Telok Ayer reclamation
text.zh: 新加坡国家文物局藏品记录：直落亚逸填海

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read by a research agent. The reclamation “began in 1879 and was completed by 1890”; NLB's Land from Sand (S76) dates the wider scheme 1879–1897. Both are kept.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。研究代理读取。填海“1879 年开始，1890 年完成”；新加坡国家图书馆管理局的《填沙造地》（S76）把整个计划定为 1879–1897 年。两者都保留。

text.en: NLB HistorySG, Yusof Ishak designated President
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 HistorySG《尤索夫·伊萨被定为总统》

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Page text extracted. Yusof Ishak “was designated President through Constitution (Amendment) Bill on 22 December 1965”; Parliament first sat on 8 December 1965.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。提取网页全文。尤索夫·伊萨“于 1965 年 12 月 22 日通过宪法（修正）法案被定为总统”；国会 1965 年 12 月 8 日首次开会。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Chinese coolies (archived copy, April 2021)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《华人苦力》（2021 年 4 月存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. A new arrival was a sin kheh; “During the 1870s and 1880s, some coolies were unwillingly shipped to Sumatra”; those not “sold” were “confined to overcrowded and filthy coolie depots”; many turned to opium and gambling; secret societies were outlawed at the start of 1890.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。新来的人叫“新客”；“1870 至 1880 年代，有些苦力被违背意愿运往苏门答腊”；没有被“卖”出去的人“被关在拥挤肮脏的苦力馆”；许多人染上鸦片和赌博；私会党在 1890 年初被取缔。

text.en: BiblioAsia, Stories of Abdullah: the Hikayat Abdullah (vol. 11 no. 4, 2016)
text.zh: 《BiblioAsia》《阿都拉的故事：〈阿都拉传〉》（第 11 卷第 4 期，2016）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Read. Abdullah was “a scribe and interpreter for Raffles”; the Hikayat was “written in Jawi … between 1840 and 1843 and published in 1849”; he was not present at the 1819 landing and pieced it together from others; later critics called him “a stooge of the British for his pro-British views”.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。已读。阿都拉是“莱佛士的文书和翻译”；《阿都拉传》“用爪夷文写于 1840 年至 1843 年，1849 年出版”；1819 年登陆时他不在场，是根据别人的叙述拼凑的；后来有评论者说他“亲英，是英国人的走狗”。

text.en: NLB Infopedia, Temenggung Abdul Rahman (archived copy, 2019)
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局 Infopedia《天猛公阿都拉曼》（2019 年存档版）

note.en: Read on 18 October 2026 for the historian review. Wayback copy read. He lived on Bulang in Riau and became Temenggong after 1806; a Dutch treaty with Johor in 1818 cut his power and income, and “shortly after” he moved to Singapore; he governed settlements of Orang Laut, Orang Seletar and Orang Kallang; his following numbered 6,000 to 10,000 in 1824; he built the Istana Lama at Telok Blangah, birthplace of his grandson Abu Bakar, and died on 8 December 1825.
note.zh: 2026 年 10 月 18 日为史学复核读取。读取 Wayback 存档。他原住廖内的布朗岛，1806 年后成为天猛公；1818 年荷兰与柔佛订约，削弱了他的权力和收入，“不久之后”他迁到新加坡；他管辖海人、实里达人和加冷人的聚落；1824 年他的追随者有 6,000 至 10,000 人；他在直落布兰雅建了旧皇宫，孙子阿布巴卡在那里出生；他于 1825 年 12 月 8 日去世。

text.en: National Library Board, Industrial Revolution: Jurong Industrial Estate development
text.zh: 国家图书馆管理局：裕廊工业区发展

note.en: Geographic chronology review only: industrial development commenced in 1961, first port wharves were constructed in 1963, port operations began in 1965, and Jurong Shipyard was established in April 1963. These dates do not delineate reclamation footprints. Modern article photographs and illustrations were not traced into the coast.
note.zh: 仅用于地图年代核对：工业区于1961年开始开发，首批码头于1963年建造，港口于1965年启用，裕廊船厂于1963年4月成立。这些日期不界定填海范围；没有描摹文章中的现代照片或插图。

text.en: JTC, Dream Factories publication introduction
text.zh: 裕廊集团：Dream Factories出版物介绍

note.en: Geographic chronology cross-check: identifies Jurong Industrial Estate as conceptualised in 1961. The introduction supplies no dated shoreline or reclamation boundary, and no geometry was copied from it.
note.zh: 地图年代核对：指出裕廊工业区于1961年构思。介绍页不提供带日期的海岸线或填海边界；没有从该页复制几何数据。
